Sentence (English): We're loving this dishwasher and have no serious complaints.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We're loving this dishwasher and have no serious complaints. A few "nitpick" items, but nothing substantial that has made us regret replacing our old dishwasher. We love the stainless finish. We've had plenty of stainless appliances over the years but this one shows far fewer fingerprints / smudges than ones we have had in the past. It always looks clean. The controls are easy to use and understand. I did not realize that there is an LED display built into the door until we ran the first cycle and I love it. You get a nice clear display of how much longer the cycle is, or if it has ended, right on the door. but when it's powered down it disappears and the door goes back to a full stainless look. I do like how the washer can receive updates over the air via the LG app, and we've pushed a few. My favorite update was the "night dry" setting which runs the drying fan during the night to remove spots. I wish the app would stop pushing notifications about new "songs", that was the first setting I changed on the washer (you can turn the beeps and songs off via the app). While we're on that topic. LG, stop making your devices play songs. I don't need to hear Beethoven at 1 AM telling me that the dishwasher is done. Your washing machines do it too and I can't stand it. Install was very easy: standard 3-wire appliance cord, standard braided dishwasher supply line, standard ribbed discharge hose. All were easy to install and secure on the machine (hint: attach these first, with the machine on it's side. THEN roll it into the cabinet space). I'm very glad that it has holes for side mounting as well as clips for top mounting. We have a granite counter with a roundover and the dishwasher top clips don't align with anything we can screw into on the top - so we have to use the side screws. I did find the dishwasher to be a little louder than our old one, even though this has a lower dB rating. The padding around the outside of our old dishwasher was much thicker than this one, which is why I think it was quieter. Ido wish they would have gone a little thicker on the padding with this one. I also think most of the noise comes from the bottom of the tub, specifically when water "falls" down to the bottom of the tub. A little extra padding there may have gone a long way towards quieting it. I was skeptical of the third rack at first, figuring we would have to give up some space on the top rack, but it turns out we use it a lot and I love it. It fits all those strange water bottle lids and straws perfectly. The third rack is removable if you do need all of the space on your middle rack. Speaking of, I love how the middle rack can adjust up or down to make a little extra room on the first rack - very handy! All around a very nice dishwasher. The dishes have been coming out sparkly clean.

Tested and confirmed, one hour start to finish but be wary, dishes are hot when it's done! Don't forget you'll need a water supply line and a pigtail for power, nice that those connections are in the front at the kick plate, though a bit awkward to get connected when the dishwasher is in place. Quiet running (if you turn off the control panel beeps). WiFi enabled so I can let the kids know when it's done to empty it out. 3 racks. Stainless tub. Dishes seemed cleaner than the one it replaced though and that was likely just age making it less efficient. All in a solid machine.

Sentence (English): Our new Bosch was installed easily and looks great.
Comments (English): [ Clean but confusing ] || ---------------- || Our new Bosch was installed easily and looks great. We washed our first load of dishes and glasses and they cleaned up well. The glasses were very wet so we adjusted the setting and used a setting that dried better. The dishwasher is still new so I can't speak to reliability but it is confusing to use. The Power button is labeled "reset 4 sec" not power. At the opposite side of the control panel on the right is the start/resume. In between the reset button and start/resume are six cycle options, Plus sanitize and extra dry, how long the cycle takes a Wi-Fi light, rinse and sanitize then the start/resume. Even though I feel very savvy at working all types of appliances, it was not easy to figure out that the reset button was actually the power on button. This dishwasher is used in our short term vacation rental and it has confused many of our guests. I tried to solve the confusing panel by buying a LabelMaker and labeling it with #1 POWER #2.START. We will see who can figure it out. Why make turning on a dishwasher so ridiculously complicated?

Sentence (English): So far it has cleaned really well.
Comments (English): [ Cleans well and is super quiet. ] || ---------------- || So far it has cleaned really well. I was weary about not rinsing prior but gave it a try. On the regular cycle it didn't get everything off so the next time I tried the heavy cycle and it got everything clean. I had trouble getting the app to connect but finally got it to work. Once you have it conntected the app lets you set wash cycles and lets you know when it is complete. The one thing that bothers me is that there is no light on the machine itself showing that the wash is complete, so if you aren't right there to here the beep or you don't see it on your phone you don't know it is done. Or in my case I have someone that comes to clean the house and there is nothing showing them that the machine is done and needs to be emptied. It is extremely quiet which is great! The basket to put silverware in is very small, about half the size of regular ones. I assume this is because they have the third rack. I actually prefer to use the basket and use the third rack for lids or serving tools instead of my silverware. The second rack won't hold some of my larger drinking glasses, even on the lowest adjusted setting so I have to put those on the bottom. Not used to putting plastic on the bottom but I have to with this one. Another thing that concerns me is the amount of water that is left behind after the drying is complete. I know they say that is the way it is supposed to be but I worry about possible mold build up if it sets for several days without being opened. I try and let the door sit open for a while after each wash to let it air out. For the price, they could make some improvements.

Sentence (English): Product is fine, if not overpriced.
Comments (English): [ Ok product, terrible support ] || ---------------- || Product is fine, if not overpriced. DO NOT buy this product or any LG appliance online with installation, though. The delivery service provider they use does not coordinate delivery and installation, so you'll be left with a boxed appliance until installation is scheduled. Installation isn't scheduled until after the unit is delivered, so you could be living with an appliance in the way for who knows how long. A local shop that can order this unit for you will at least install it on the same day, and probably do a better job anyway.LG customer support is, if I'm being polite, absolutely pointless. The "AI" chatbot does nothing at all, like doesn't even do better than searching their website for information. Their live agent chat is pretty bad, and in general isn't going to really do anything for you besides call an LG repair location near you. They base their referral to local repair on the schedule that the local company gives them, so you're almost guaranteed to get better and faster service by just calling an LG authorized repair person yourself.The only good thing I can say about LG is that you can usually buy parts for newer products, you can sometimes find parts for older products, and most of their appliance manuals have wiring diagrams and some basic trouble shooting steps that are good if you're handy enough to do your own repairs. If you aren't, be prepared to replace extra boards and components when the repair technician comes to your house.I've got several LG devices in my house, laundry washer and dryer, fridge, TV, sound system, even a computer monitor. But the support experience I've had with them likely means that as these units need replacing or expensive repair, I'm just ditching LG entirely. Nobody needs to be this frustrated when they need support or service.

So. called Costco, and in the end the very helpful customer service agent could not schedule it for the time/day I could be home and not at work, and so they canceled the order and refunded my money. Maybe it's time to allow customers to schedule the delivery window online when they purchase furniture, appliances, or other big ticket items? It does not come with an insulating blanket to dampen the noise though it's not needed. It does not come with a drain hose clamp to hold it on to the garage disposal. And a few coupons to help you get interested in buying the product again. The drain hose is on the left side of the dishwasher and it is long enough to reach around to make it to the garbage disposal if it's on the right side of the machine. Of course the drain hose is included on the side of the dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I have owned this dishwasher for about a year now.
Comments (English): [ Pretty but no customer service for warranty repair ] || ---------------- || I have owned this dishwasher for about a year now. It has a lot of bells and whistles so it is difficult to know if it is working properly. It has different music chimes to let you know that the cycle has finished or to warn you of things, but ours randomly chimes throughout the cycle, without showing an error code, and even when the dishwasher is empty. The worst was when it woke us up at 4 am because it decided to start singing. The cycle completed hours earlier and no error codes were shown on the unit or in the app. I finally called for service because nothing I tried was helping. Calling service was the biggest wrestling match I've seen since high school. They are obviously trained to schedule a service call as a last resort. The first time I called, I told the robot that I wanted service and was placed in a queue until the call was answered. Then the call hung up. When I called back the robot asked if the concern was related to the issue the operator help me resolve previously. Laughable. This was on a Saturday so maybe they were closed, but the robot never mentioned anything about being closed. I called next on a Wednesday and finally got to talk to a human (after the robot transferred me). The operator had no clue what I was describing and told me to try the same things that are in the troubleshooting guide in the manual. LG had no record of me being a customer even though I registered the unit on their app when I bought it. They told me to contact the store where I bought it and get a receipt and text it to them so they could confirm that I bought their dishwasher. The operator actually called me back when he said he would so props for that. I was transferred two more times with each person trying harder and harder to not schedule a service appointment. I was threatened (reminded) many times that if they come out and the issues are my fault, I would be charged for the visit and the warranty wouldn't cover it. The final woman started telling me that the beeping and singing was normal and that it would go away on its own. She must have lost her bonus for the month because I insisted that someone come out and look at the dishwasher and she finally agreed to schedule me. It took me over 2.5 hours to schedule my service appointment from the time I first called. The service technician that came out was friendly, but didn't even test the dishwasher or ask about symptoms. He brought a new motherboard with him and replaced it and left in under 20 minutes. Obviously, he knew exactly what was wrong with the dishwasher.

Outstanding connectivity and app control, Quiet, plenty of wash options, dries well, and was easy to DIY install. I recommend this product.

Sentence (English): It gets the dishes really clean, and if opened right after cycle ends it also dries them pretty well.
Comments (English): [ A couple helpful tips for this dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || It gets the dishes really clean, and if opened right after cycle ends it also dries them pretty well. It's very quiet. What I don't like is the short cords as that kind of limits where I can put it. And it's hard to see when the cycle ends so I can open it right then. My solution to see when it ends: I set a timer for 48 minutes when I started the lite cycle. It actually goes a little longer, maybe 55 minutes. I sat in a chair in front of it and could see the 3 blue lights that were on because there is a little space where you can see the lights, just can't see what they are. If I was standing I couldn't see them because I'd be above it. I waited for the beep to signal it was done. It kind of a short musical chime, sounds different than the error beeps. Once I heard that I could see that 2 of the lights went off. I opened it, a lot of hot steam came out and I left it open and within a few minutes most of the dishes were dry. Next time I won't have to sit there, I'll know how long it takes and what to listen for and what lights to look for. I like using the short cycle, so far that works fine for me.

Sentence (English): I bought a Samsung Biscoc dishwasher for 6 people as a gift for my parents-in-law on Parents' Day. *
Comments (English): [ It doesn't seem like a bad idea as a gift for parents-in-law or as a filial piety gift. ] || ---------------- || I bought a Samsung Biscoc dishwasher for 6 people as a gift for my parents-in-law on Parents' Day. *User review* (Review by actual user mother) The internal capacity was smaller than I thought, so it was not enough for a two-person household to eat two meals. If it takes ~50 minutes to eat one meal and wash, it seems faster to wash it by hand, but it is convenient and satisfactory to use it when you have oily food, a lot of dishes, or when you are tired. You can select from 5 different courses and options by pressing the course button, and you can customize the washing according to the degree of contamination of the dishes. Compared to the dishwasher I used 10 years ago, the sterilization system that sterilizes the washing bin is reassuring, and after the washing process is finished, it automatically opens and dries, so the inside and outside are ventilated, so I am very satisfied, but in the end, I end up doing light dishwashing by hand. There was a defect in the product during installation, so I received it again, but I received the product quickly, and the installer kindly explained the product and the course, so my mother and father said it was easy to use.
Comments (Original): [ 시부모님 어버이날 선물 혹은 효도선물로 나쁘지 않은 듯 ] || ---------------- || 어버이날 시부모님 선물로 삼성 비스코크 식기세척기 6인용 구매해서 드렸습니다.  *사용후기 *(실 사용자 어머님의 후기)  생각보다 내부 용량이 작은 편이라 2인 가구 2끼 먹고 사용하기엔 부족했습니다.  한끼 먹고 세척에 ~50분 사용시간이라면 손세척을 하는게 오히려 빠를 것 같지만  기름기 많은 음식을 담았을 때나, 접시가 많을 때, 피곤할 때 사용하니 편하고 만족스럽다.  코스 버튼을 눌러 다양한 5가지 코스 및 옵션을 선택할 수 있는데 그릇의 오염 정도에 따라 맞춤 세척이 가능하며.  10년전 사용한 식기세척기에 비해 세척통까지 통살균되는 살균 시스템이 안심이 되며  세척과정이 끝난 후 자동으로 열러서  건조까지 되어서 외내부 환기가 되어 아주 만족 하지만 결국엔 가벼운 설거지는  손으로 하게 된다.  설치 시 제품 하자가 있어서 다시 받았는데 빠르게 제품 받았으며 설치하시는 기사분께서 제품 설명과 코스 설명을 친절하게 해주셔서 어머님,아버님 사용이 쉬웠다고 하심

Sentence (English): I recently replaced a Fisher and Paykel double dish drawer, which I loved.
Comments (English): [ It is beautiful on the outside. ] || ---------------- || I recently replaced a Fisher and Paykel double dish drawer, which I loved. I was ready to purchase another one again when I noticed that GE had recently come out with a dish drawer. Since my kitchen is all GE I decided to go for it. I am somewhat disappointed, the outside is pretty, but that is the only part I like. This is not user friendly like the Fisher and Paykel, the quality is much reduced, it feels more plasticky and cheap. The drawer doesn't feel as smooth when it opens. One thing I really dislike is when you wash the dishes and let them sit for a while or even the next day they become very wet because the moisture builds up inside. My old dishwasher didn't do that. It does say on the instructions to empty as soon as they are dry or you will get moisture. That is ridiculous. The whole point is to wash and empty at your leisure. The finish sound is so faint you can't tell when dishes are dry and if you open too soon it stops the cycle and then you again, have wet dishes. The inside if the tub is so cheap and poorly made, the little trays are so cheap I am worried to break them off. If I had to do this again, I would not get this and order a Fisher and Paykel even though the cost is 1000.00 more than this. I am very bummed and to top it off, when I hired Home depot to install this dishwasher they couldn't do it, and damaged my cabinets in the process and now we are waiting for a claim from Home depot to repair the brand new cabinets that they just put it. This whole process was somewhat of a nightmare and we are stuck with this for a few years at least.

Sentence (English): We replaced our prior Bosch with this new Bosch about 2 months ago.
Comments (English): [ Excellent Product ] || ---------------- || We replaced our prior Bosch with this new Bosch about 2 months ago. It is very quiet, has 3 shelves and dries better than our previous one. You do need to use a dishwashing aid, but the program alerts you when you are low, so you know to add more. Unfortunately the sales person at Best Buy and the installer had no idea why there was WiFi nor what it does, so we didn't set it up at first. Now that it set up I get alerts when the dishwasher is complete and when to clean it and add Finish. It does an excellent job of cleaning and sanitizing the dishes. My only complaint is our old dishwasher allowed me to wash my very large dinner plates and this one does not (because I need room in the rack above for tall cups like Yeti's). It seems the new version is smaller on the inside than the previous model. I just don't use those plates now very often or wash them by hand.

We tried doing that, but it takes more time to load and unload, so we ordered the conventional basket. It seems Bosch didn't think through the ease of use. The second minor negative is that the option to link the machine to one's wifi and get access to an assortment of customizable wash cycles is time-consuming with no noticeable advantage in washing plates and other kitchenware. It's much easier and quicker to just push the automatic cycle button on the machine.

Sentence (English): Look, if you're here then you probably already know this, but I'm going to say it anyway.
Comments (English): [ Dish Domination ] || ---------------- || Look, if you're here then you probably already know this, but I'm going to say it anyway. The Bosch 800 series is the best thing to happen to dishes since cake. Don't like pre-rinsing? Bosch 800 series don't care. Throw those things in, push a button, and prepare for immaculate tableware. Have a lot of dishes? Good. The 800 series loves a lot of dishes. The three rack system has a near infinite amount of adjustments, the Bosch can handle whatever you've got. Be an adult - buy yourself an 800 series and stop playing tetris with those tongs. Don't want your plastic stuff melting enough to resemble a Salvador Dali painting? Bosch 800 series has got you. With their crazy new volcanic rock drying sorcery, the only difference between the plastic utensils and containers you put in and the plastic utensils and containers you take out is that they're clean. And don't get me started on all the whiz bang tech stuff they put in their app. Do I need to adjust the cleaning intensity by quadrant in my dishwasher? No. But I can - because I have a Bosch 800 series and they have somehow delivered a dishwasher from the future. I mean, I remote started the thing in the app just to feel what transcending the physical realm of buttons felt like. Spoiler: it was great. Oh yeah, and the thing is quiet. Like, eerily quiet. Like sometimes I'll turn on the TV just to hear something quiet. All in all, quit acting like you're even considering other dishwashers and buy the Bosch 800 series like you were planning to do all along. Or, you know, don't. and wait the decade it's going to take for other manufacturers to catch up.

Comments (English): [ Awesome performance and cleaning - vs Bosch 500 ] || ---------------- || Love everything about the dishwasher. Great options on cleaning. No need for wi-fi to get all of your cleaning options. Plenty of room and very large silverware basket. I never do pots in my dishwasher, so not sure if it's workable for those that do. The reason I'm doing this review is so others know that I did buy the 5 yr warranty (I always do) and after 4.5 years it errored out and the technician couldn't fix meaning a replacement for me so I chose a Bosch at the recommendation of the tech and my husband. My thoughts on the Bosch - 500 Series 24\" Top Control Smart Built-In I got is MEH. The racking system is meant for doing pots in the bottom so upper shelves are jacked up with less space and no adjustment available. I did notice the silver basket was very small so I kept the very large kitchen Aid one which fits thank goodness. It did take quite a few try's to connect the WiFi which gives you the other options. I'm puzzled on the bottom light because it did show red while operating but when I looked in the morning it was not showing green for completed so no idea if it completed but the dishes appeared to be clean, rinsed and pretty dry. Overall I'd choose this KitchenAid again

See photos- When shopping online I did notice the silver basket was very small so I kept the very large kitchen Aid one which fits thank goodness. The second drawer can't be moved down and even pulling out the top drawer has a very tight fit for over sized glasses and the other side not at all. If you do pots then likely the bottom rack is perfect for you. My biggest suggestion to Bosch is to have adjustable racking for the second drawer. It did take quite a few try's to connect the WiFi which gives you the other options. I really can't figure out the app so I think it's really a waste for the consumer and a boon for Bosch for data collection. I'm puzzled on the bottom light because it did show red while operating but when I looked in the morning it was not showing green for completed so no idea if it completed but the dishes appeared to be clean, rinsed and pretty dry. On my KitchenAid the completed light stayed on until opened. The app is really disappointing to as it doesn't show yo what cycle it's on only how many minutes are left, so weird. We'll see if it lasts 5 years. Overall I'd choose the KitchenAid again

Sentence (English): Love everything about the dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Awesome performance and cleaning - vs Bosch 500 ] || ---------------- || Love everything about the dishwasher. Great options on cleaning. No need for wi-fi to get all of your cleaning options. Plenty of room and very large silverware basket. I never do pots in my dishwasher, so not sure if it's workable for those that do. The reason I'm doing this review is so others know that I did buy the 5 yr warranty (I always do) and after 4.5 years it errored out and the technician couldn't fix meaning a replacement for me so I chose a Bosch at the recommendation of the tech and my husband. My thoughts on the Bosch - 500 Series 24" Top Control Smart Built-In I got is MEH. The racking system is meant for doing pots in the bottom so upper shelves are jacked up with less space and no adjustment available. I did notice the silver basket was very small so I kept the very large kitchen Aid one which fits thank goodness. It did take quite a few try's to connect the WiFi which gives you the other options. I'm puzzled on the bottom light because it did show red while operating but when I looked in the morning it was not showing green for completed so no idea if it completed but the dishes appeared to be clean, rinsed and pretty dry. Overall I'd choose this KitchenAid again

It felt bad to see my husband sweating profusely while washing dishes, and I was also having a hard time, so I made up my mind to look into it and found a cost-effective 6-person dishwasher on the media! These days, there are a lot of advertisements for 3-person mini dishwashers, but after all, we don't use a soup bowl and a rice bowl every time we eat, and we have a lot of plates and cups. I saw reviews of mini dishwashers and they said they are suitable for 1-2 people and definitely not for 3 people. There are only two of us, but we tend to have a lot of dishes, so by dinnertime, there would always be a lot of dishes piled up, so we couldn't wash them all at once, so we had to divide them into two or three times, apply detergent, and rinse them repeatedly. So! I purchased a 6-person Media dishwasher and it took 3-4 days to install. For reference, they called me at 8:20 a.m. and came a little after 9:00 a.m. to install it. However, they said they needed additional plumbing, so I paid an additional 20,000 won for the plumbing. The manual recommended powdered detergent over liquid, so I purchased powdered detergent and rinse separately. I finally got around to using it the night after installation. Loading the dishes in the 6-person, single-stage dishwasher was incredibly easy! It washes dishes at 40-50 degrees Celsius and they come out clean. I thought it was taking too long, but it's a huge improvement, as it significantly reduces the amount of dishes I have to wash, giving me more time to watch TV with my husband. I really like the price, which is in the early 200,000 won range, and the 5-year free warranty from Coupang Ansim Care. That's why I'm going to Coupang! Don't hesitate, beginners, and try it out! There are only two of us, but we tend to have a lot of dishes, so by dinnertime, there would always be a lot of dishes piled up, so we couldn't wash them all at once, so we had to divide them into two or three times, apply detergent, and rinse them repeatedly. So! I purchased a 6-person Media dishwasher and it took 3-4 days to install. For reference, they called me at 8:20 a.m. and came a little after 9:00 a.m. to install it. My house doesn't have a countertop, so there's a gap between the sink and the dishwasher, so they didn't drill any holes. However, they said they needed additional plumbing, so I paid an additional 20,000 won for the plumbing. The manual recommended powdered detergent over liquid, so I purchased powdered detergent and rinse separately. I finally got around to using it the night after installation. Loading the dishes in the 6-person, single-stage dishwasher was incredibly easy! It washes dishes at 40-50 degrees Celsius and they come out clean. I thought it was taking too long, but it's a huge improvement, as it significantly reduces the amount of dishes I have to wash, giving me more time to watch TV with my husband. Sentence (English): I purchased a 6-person Media dishwasher and it took 3-4 days to install.
Comments (English): [ Living comfortably on less than 200,000 won! ] || ---------------- || Date of purchase: 2024.06.06 Date of installation: 2024.06.09 I moved and got a bigger house, so I was thinking about getting a dishwasher, but washing dishes is already hard, and it's even harder in the summer. It felt bad to see my husband sweating profusely while washing dishes, and I was also having a hard time, so I made up my mind to look into it and found a cost-effective 6-person dishwasher on the media! These days, there are a lot of advertisements for 3-person mini dishwashers, but after all, we don't use a soup bowl and a rice bowl every time we eat, and we have a lot of plates and cups. I saw reviews of mini dishwashers and they said they are suitable for 1-2 people and definitely not for 3 people. There are only two of us, but we tend to have a lot of dishes, so by dinnertime, there would always be a lot of dishes piled up, so we couldn't wash them all at once, so we had to divide them into two or three times, apply detergent, and rinse them repeatedly. So! I purchased a 6-person Media dishwasher and it took 3-4 days to install. For reference, they called me at 8:20 a.m. and came a little after 9:00 a.m. to install it. My house doesn't have a countertop, so there's a gap between the sink and the dishwasher, so they didn't drill any holes. However, they said they needed additional plumbing, so I paid an additional 20,000 won for the plumbing. The manual recommended powdered detergent over liquid, so I purchased powdered detergent and rinse separately. I finally got around to using it the night after installation. Loading the dishes in the 6-person, single-stage dishwasher was incredibly easy! It washes dishes at 40-50 degrees Celsius and they come out clean. I'm not sure about other dishwashers, but this one takes 29 minutes on the fast cycle, and 1 hour and 19 minutes on the standard cycle. I thought it was taking too long, but it's a huge improvement, as it significantly reduces the amount of dishes I have to wash, giving me more time to watch TV with my husband. The controls are intuitive, but I'm not sure about the p1 and p2 cycles. I thought it might be confusing because it's like this, so I just put labels on the ones I'll be using most often! The dishwasher isn't that noisy. I don't think it's annoying! The hood above my induction stove is louder. I really like the price, which is in the early 200,000 won range, and the 5-year free warranty from Coupang Ansim Care. That's why I'm going to Coupang! Don't hesitate, beginners, and try it out! I hope my review was helpful. If you found it helpful, please give it a like!

Sentence (English): Loading the dishes in the 6-person, single-stage dishwasher was incredibly easy!
Comments (English): [ Living comfortably on less than 200,000 won! ] || ---------------- || Date of purchase: 2024.06.06 Date of installation: 2024.06.09 I moved and got a bigger house, so I was thinking about getting a dishwasher, but washing dishes is already hard, and it's even harder in the summer. It felt bad to see my husband sweating profusely while washing dishes, and I was also having a hard time, so I made up my mind to look into it and found a cost-effective 6-person dishwasher on the media! These days, there are a lot of advertisements for 3-person mini dishwashers, but after all, we don't use a soup bowl and a rice bowl every time we eat, and we have a lot of plates and cups. I saw reviews of mini dishwashers and they said they are suitable for 1-2 people and definitely not for 3 people. There are only two of us, but we tend to have a lot of dishes, so by dinnertime, there would always be a lot of dishes piled up, so we couldn't wash them all at once, so we had to divide them into two or three times, apply detergent, and rinse them repeatedly. So! I purchased a 6-person Media dishwasher and it took 3-4 days to install. For reference, they called me at 8:20 a.m. and came a little after 9:00 a.m. to install it. My house doesn't have a countertop, so there's a gap between the sink and the dishwasher, so they didn't drill any holes. However, they said they needed additional plumbing, so I paid an additional 20,000 won for the plumbing. The manual recommended powdered detergent over liquid, so I purchased powdered detergent and rinse separately. I finally got around to using it the night after installation. Loading the dishes in the 6-person, single-stage dishwasher was incredibly easy! It washes dishes at 40-50 degrees Celsius and they come out clean. I'm not sure about other dishwashers, but this one takes 29 minutes on the fast cycle, and 1 hour and 19 minutes on the standard cycle. I thought it was taking too long, but it's a huge improvement, as it significantly reduces the amount of dishes I have to wash, giving me more time to watch TV with my husband. The controls are intuitive, but I'm not sure about the p1 and p2 cycles. I thought it might be confusing because it's like this, so I just put labels on the ones I'll be using most often! The dishwasher isn't that noisy. I don't think it's annoying! The hood above my induction stove is louder. Sentence (English): This was our first and last Samsung appliance.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher Until It Wasn't. AVOID Samsung!  ] || ---------------- || This was our first and last Samsung appliance. We bought for our new home because of reviews, price, and features. For about 2 yrs 11 mos, this dishwasher worked great and was super quiet. It was easy to install and had a nice finish within the cabinet. Then comes the noisy operation, probably doubling the decibel level, but still working. I'm handy so I researched and found videos of similar issues and how to fix. Everything leaned towards having debris, like plastic, stuck in the food grinding mechanism. I took it apart and found nothing in the system. Because we pre-rinse, there was barely any grime in there. It wasn't the drain pump making the noise so the only other culprit is the main motor. Between the cost of the motor and how difficult it would be to replace, we said we would just deal with the noise. Two months later, error code pointing to a leak. We had to unplug because it kept turning itself on and off. Time for a replacement! I might expect a product to last 3 years if I bought the bottom of the line dishwasher, but I didn't expect Samsung to be in that range. So I paid $220/yr for a piece of junk appliance. Now that I'm researching a new dishwasher, I've reviewed the well known consumer review information for 2024, and surprise surprise, Samsung are some of the worst models having reliability ratings of 2 out of 5 or 3 out of 5. They nailed it! Stay away from Samsung dishwashers!

Sentence (English): The installation instructions feel as big as the dishwasher itself, which isn't a bad thing.
Comments (English): [ Washing result very good, however instructions too vague ] || ---------------- || The installation instructions feel as big as the dishwasher itself, which isn't a bad thing. The problem is that the process steps are mixed up and some steps are a bit imprecise because the instructions there overlap. It's also confusing that some steps are identical. I suspect that this is a universal manual, but I don't know exactly why I skipped a few steps without it affecting the end result. The positive thing is that you get video instructions for many of the steps! I would have found it better, in addition to the video instructions, if there had been a small instruction booklet rather than such a huge poster jumping out at me. And the individual process steps had been written down in a more relaxed manner so that 5 steps weren't condensed into one. Otherwise the dishwasher is great and I'm happy with it and glad I don't have to wash dishes by hand anymore.
Comments (Original): [ Spülergebnis Sehr Gut, Anleitung jedoch zu ungenau ] || ---------------- || Die Installationsanleitung ist gefühlt genau so groß wie die Spülmaschine selbst, was erstmal nichts negatives ist. Problem ist jedoch, dass die Prozessschritte durcheinander liegen und einige Schritte etwas ungenau sind da sich die dortigen Instruktionen überlappen. Verwirrend ist auch, dass dort manche Schritte identisch sind. Ich vermute das es sich dabei um eine Universal Anleitung handelt jedoch weiß ich es nicht genau weshalb ich einige Schritte übersprungen habe ohne dass dies das Endergebnis beeinflusst hat.Das positive ist, dass man für viele Schritte auch eine Videoanleitung bekommt!Besser hätte ich es gefunden, neben der Videoanleitung, wenn dort ein kleines Anleitungsbuch wäre und mir nicht so nen riesen Poster entgegen gesprungen kommt... Und die einzelnen Prozessschritte aufgelockerter aufgeschrieben wären sodass man nicht 5 Schritte in einem zusammengefasst hat.Ansonsten ist die Spülmaschine Top und ich bin damit zufrieden und glücklich nicht mehr per Hand abzuwaschen.

Sentence (English): I ordered a KitchenAid KDTM704KPS including installation & haul away.
Comments (English): [ Wrong Brand of Dishwasher Delivered! ] || ---------------- || I ordered a KitchenAid KDTM704KPS including installation & haul away. On 6/4/24, the installer arrived on time with the dishwasher. He easily removed the old dishwasher and took it outside. He proceeded to take the new dishwasher off his truck and unboxed it. The generic box had the correct labels printed on it, ie. my name & address and KitchenAid KDTM704KPS. So far, so good. As the installer was arranging the broken down boxes on his truck, I noticed that the new dishwasher said "Whirlpool", not KitchenAid. Since Whirlpool makes KitchenAid, I didn't panic just yet. But, I did look further. Inside the dishwasher I found the fixed stamp with the official model number and serial no. It said Mod WDT970SAKZ1 and Ser No. FC*******. See attached photo (if I can figure out how). Sorry, but that's not what I ordered. The installer contacted the local Lowe's. They said that they didn't have that model in stock and also that this was an on-line special directly from the manufacturer. They couldn't do anything except have the installer re-install the old dishwasher and have me come in to place an order for a new dishwasher at the store. So, I drove to the store and did that. They had to refund my credit card, but couldn't tell me how long it would take and then charge my credit card for the new dishwasher. I'm not happy about that, but I wasn't going to take it out on the Lowe's store employee who was doing her best to straighten out something she had no control of. She said that it would probably be over 2 weeks before the new dishwasher arrived. She couldn't be sure, but said they would be in touch. This was a Whirlpool mistake that should never have happened. I am not happy! Maybe Whirlpool can figure out what happened and put in new procedures to ensure it doesn't happen again.

Sentence (English): This LG Dishwasher is sharp looking.
Comments (English): [ Excellent Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This LG Dishwasher is sharp looking. We opted for the handle-less appearance. The dishwasher we had previously wasn't garbage, but we knew we wanted to upgrade to something that could help take some of the work out of our hands. Dishwashers are one of the few things left that you can buy, and you get a better product if you pay a little more money. This dishwasher is worth paying more. It doesn't operate at a noiseless decibel. You can still hear it working, but it's considerably quieter than our old one. One of the huge advantages of buying an LG dishwasher is the LG Thinq app. You can download the app to your phone and use the app to do several different functions. The coolest part of the app to me is the ability to monitor your washing status, and it even tracks your washing history, so you know how many washes between suggested maintenance you've done. For maintenance, you add a cleaner and then let the machine do the work for you. There's a filter you can clean as well but it's super easy to handle. The app also allows you to download special functions. I like to make sure my dishes are completely dry, so one of the features I downloaded was a dry-only mode. You can run dishes in the evening and then start a dry-only mode later and wake up to a dish washer full of completely dry dishes if you wanted. The features include other options like pots and pans cleaning. Super cool, so I included a picture of that app page for you to see. My wife and I really like the ability to receive notifications to our phones when the wash load is completed. When you close the door to the washer, there's a secure click feeling that lets you know it's closed properly. It's not a cheap click, but a quality secure click feeling. The washer has a third rack which is great for washing utensils that otherwise clutter up the silverware tray. My wife loves the fact that the app lets you change the chimes that announce the load is complete. There are many options and even some that are season themed. The washer has a dry-boost feature that helps get your dishes drier than not using that feature. Without that feature, the dishes didn't seem very dry. We used a rinse-aide liquid and the entire bottle emptied into the compartment, so it holds a lot of that liquid. Maybe the most important different overall from our old washer to the new one is that ever load of dishes finishes with not spots on the dishes. Ever dish is fully cleaned on every type of wash cycle we've tried. When installing the washer, the unit can be connected and pushed into place and the entire machine is leveled upward from the bottom front of the unit. Very easy to use, and very high-quality machine. I cannot think of a single detractor from buying this machine.

Sentence (English): I purchased this dishwasher and it's been in use for a few weeks.
Comments (English): [ Cleans great and has 3 well designed racks. ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher and it's been in use for a few weeks. It cleans really well and dries better than my last dishwasher, which was a European brand starting with a 'B'. I pretty much like everything about this dishwasher, especially the top rack, silverware basket and adjustable shelves and the interior light. It does make some noise, and while it's quiet, it is no where near 'silent' like my last dishwasher was. The downside is the installation, and I've done a lot of appliance installs. The insulation is a pain to keep square on the unit while sliding it into the opening. Unlike other brands that have a more 'installed on' insulation that stays put, this one just drapes on the machine and gets caught up while sliding the machine in. Except for that one annoyance which is a one time issue, I'd recommend this machine.

Comments (English): [ Super quiet, but shop around if you can ] || ---------------- || This is the quietest dishwasher I have ever had. If it didn't have a timer running I wouldn't't know if it was working. However, I am experiences issues with the Bosch 300. All of my plastic items continue to smell and carry the taste of soap. It's quite unpleasant. I've loaded the rinse aid dispenser, and read the troubleshooting section of the manual. I've also tried many different settings. Nothing seems to work except for the 1 troubleshooting suggestion, which was to hand wash the dishes. (Whats the point of a dishwasher if it can't clean dishes? ) Also, frequently my drinking glasses come out cloudy and spotty. My old Bosch worked like a dream, but at 12 years old I thought it was best to replace it. With this new Bosch, it has a lot of features, like I can start it with my phone! For the life of me I cannot come up with a scenario in which that would ever be helpful or even useful. I do wish one of the features wash to clean my dishes the 1st time through, without any hand washing necessary. Literally a redundant process.For Context, I cook 6 nights a week as well as breakfasts, occasional lunches, snacks and baking. I run the dishwasher at least once a day, sometimes twice.

Sentence (English): I am a two-person household.
Comments (English): I am a two-person household. I had a lot of concerns about buying a dishwasher. They say that the bigger the dishwasher, the better, but we ended up buying a 6-person one. -Reasons for buying a 6-person one- 1. I am a two-person household, and I don't cook a lot of meals at home. 2. I can't stand the dishes piling up in the sink, and if I buy a large-capacity one, I won't be able to store them for several days because the amount of dishes is small, so I think I'll just do it by hand. 3. I often see reviews saying that it's hard to put in and take out dishes from the bottom in the case of a large-capacity one. 4. It's hard to install because it's not self-contained (Of course, it's possible to stand it up, but I bought a 6-person one for the same reason.) -Review after using it- Nevertheless, sometimes when I use a lot of pots or frying pans, it's small and a bit annoying. But since I bought a 6-person one, I think I end up using it more often, so I'm satisfied and using it. Since it's a two-person household, I also got rid of one of the spoon holders, and there's a part on the tray where you can open and close the plate holder, so I think it's more useful. At first, I put the dishes in the I don't know how to stack them, but I'll get the hang of it as I keep doing it. I can put in more than I thought if there's not a lot of dishes, so I sometimes put in frying pans and pots and turn them on. -Installation review- When I first installed it, I worried a lot about the direction of the dishwasher. I initially installed it like in the picture, and it's super convenient to have the door open toward the sink bowl. If you have the right direction, put it like that! I've turned the door opening direction 90 degrees to face the front since I've installed an additional water purifier, but the water drops a little more than I thought after larvae hatch, so I bought an additional diatomaceous earth mat on the floor to compensate. Sentence (English): For years, I was debating whether or not to get a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I bought the kitchen aunt's dishwasher that everyone raves about. ] || ---------------- || For years, I was debating whether or not to get a dishwasher. Finally, I decided to get one when I moved. After deciding to get one, I was second-guessing which brand to buy. After watching a YouTube video comparing the performance and pros and cons of each dishwasher model, I decided on this one! The bottom line is... I haven't felt any major drawbacks or regrets yet. This might be because I thoroughly researched the pros and cons of this model before buying it. Coupang was having a small sale at the time, so I ordered it right away. This was my first time using a dishwasher. To install a dishwasher, I had to remove the existing sink. I didn't know where to store it. Wow, a whole sink as big as the dishwasher came off. I had to store it in a cabinet, but I was in a panic because I had nowhere to put it. I successfully installed the dishwasher. I also learned for the first time that you need dishwasher-specific salt to use it. Dishwashers, huh? They're not easy. Also, it goes without saying that you need dishwasher-specific detergent. Spoons and chopsticks go in the top row, bowls in the second, and large frying pans and pots in the bottom. Stacking too many bowls can make it difficult to wash thoroughly. I even washed my tumbler, but it still left some water stains. Overall, it washes cleanly. After washing, the door opens slightly to dry with hot air. You have to be careful so the kids don't get hurt by the hot steam. It's a touch-sensitive button operation. It doesn't hold as many bowls as I thought. There have been a few grains of rice stuck to it occasionally. So far, I haven't noticed any fishy smells or serious stains. People say, "Aw, you can't live without a dishwasher. You're the kitchen aunt." In my house, on days when my husband is away, there are only a small amount of dishes to wash. So, I just wash the dishes. On days when my husband eats a lot of dinner at home, there are endless dishes, so on days like that, I just run the dishwasher for free~! But I think it's definitely more convenient than not having anything. It's just my personality, but I prefer to wash things myself. Should I say that I feel better that way? Maybe that's why I don't give high praise like other people say, "Wow, Auntie, I love you so much." But it's better than not having anything.

Comments (English): [ I bought the kitchen aunt's dishwasher that everyone raves about. ] || ---------------- || For years, I was debating whether or not to get a dishwasher. Finally, I decided to get one when I moved. After deciding to get one, I was second-guessing which brand to buy. After watching a YouTube video comparing the performance and pros and cons of each dishwasher model, I decided on this one! The bottom line is... I haven't felt any major drawbacks or regrets yet. This might be because I thoroughly researched the pros and cons of this model before buying it. Coupang was having a small sale at the time, so I ordered it right away. This was my first time using a dishwasher. To install a dishwasher, I had to remove the existing sink. I didn't know where to store it. Wow, a whole sink as big as the dishwasher came off. I had to store it in a cabinet, but I was in a panic because I had nowhere to put it. I successfully installed the dishwasher. I also learned for the first time that you need dishwasher-specific salt to use it. Dishwashers, huh? They're not easy. Also, it goes without saying that you need dishwasher-specific detergent. Spoons and chopsticks go in the top row, bowls in the second, and large frying pans and pots in the bottom. Stacking too many bowls can make it difficult to wash thoroughly. I even washed my tumbler, but it still left some water stains. Overall, it washes cleanly. After washing, the door opens slightly to dry with hot air. You have to be careful so the kids don't get hurt by the hot steam. It's a touch-sensitive button operation. It doesn't hold as many bowls as I thought. There have been a few grains of rice stuck to it occasionally. So far, I haven't noticed any fishy smells or serious stains. People say, "Aw, you can't live without a dishwasher. You're the kitchen aunt." In my house, on days when my husband is away, there are only a small amount of dishes to wash. So, I just wash the dishes. Maybe that's why I don't give high praise like other people say, "Wow, Auntie, I love you so much." But it's better than not having anything.

Sentence (English): After my old dishwasher finally failed I was rushed to find a replacement.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 300 Series Dishwasher SHS43CF5N ] || ---------------- || After my old dishwasher finally failed I was rushed to find a replacement. I read numerous reviews on line and in periodicals and found the Bosch 300 was highly rated, met my needs and luckily on sale for $300 off. I opted to do my own installation as I had done with the previous dishwasher because the electrical and water supply are somewhat vintage in my historical home. Even though the directions to install the Bosch were straght forward and made perfect sense there were some glitches to get around. Due to the fact the old dishwasher hookups came from under the dishwasher cabinet from the basement rather than from the adjacent sink cabinent required some improvising. This required removing the water and electrical hookups from the DW cabinet and moving them to the area underneath in the basement which was easier than installing new hookups in the sink cabinents. Other than that the install went smoothly by cutting a hole in the DW cabinent floor instead of the side of the sink cabinet. The DW drain hose still goes through the side of the sink cabinent to the garbage disposal as before. The only difference is the electrical and water supply comes through the floor from the basement instead of through the side of the sink cabinent. This all took two days to accomplish but I'm glad I did it than expecting the Lowe's installers to have to figure it out. Other than that glitch all is working very well and I am very satisfied with how efficient and quiet this machine is. And the stainless steel is so nice and easy to take care of. It's a beautiful machine and I expect it to last until the next owners have to think about how to replace it.

Sentence (English): I've been using the dishwasher for about a month now and I'm very pleased with its performance.
Comments (English): [ Meets all performance expectations. ] || ---------------- || I've been using the dishwasher for about a month now and I'm very pleased with its performance. It seems to have more room than my old machine and I've noticed a big improvement on how my glasses look now. It's also very quiet. It's the first time I've had a mobile app connected to my dishwasher and so far it's not been any nuisance. I've gotten messages when the loads have finished and the mobile app let me know when I needed to add more Finish product for glasses to come out spotless. I've purchased other kitchen appliances this year and they all seem to have wifi connectivity. It can be over the top, but some of it is OK. My old dishwasher was actually a Costco Signature brand and had been hardwired for electricity. Since the new dishwasher came with a plug, I had to call Bosch and purchase a separate connector for about $25. No problems there. One thing of note was that Bosch had a separate rebate plan recently that I applied for on my own, separate from Costco. Bosch rejected my application because they said Costco was not an authorized dealer. That seemed odd, but I'm still happy with the dishwasher and the fact that I purchased it from Costco, since I'm sure I would have paid more at another retailer.

Sentence (English): The control panel frequently doesn't work.
Comments (English): [ Poor Quality Electronic Control Panel ] || ---------------- || The control panel frequently doesn't work. Often, when you press a button on the electronic control panel. the function you try to set is not selected. When you finally have the options set, pressing the start button results in a beep, but upon closing the door the cycle doesn't start. If I open the door, press start again, and close the door, the dishwasher usually starts. Sometimes I must do this twice. The control panel also gets "confused", where the light for every option is lit, but pressing the buttons has no effect. Pressing the Power/Reset button for several seconds sometimes clears this condition. Though it may require waiting several seconds and trying again. I am glad I bought the extended warranty from the dealer, since the electronics are sure to fail. I did install the Android "Home Connect" smart phone app because it provides access to features not available on the control panel. As with many smart phone apps, the dishwasher app has a poor user interface and is not worth using (I have been a software developer for 40 years and find many apps and websites full of bugs). I was appaled that Bosch does NOT include a hardcopy owners manual with the dishwasher. It comes with an inadequate quick start guide. A "real" 40 page owner's manual can be downloaded from the website. Bosch should have included the full manual given that retail price is $1,319. On a positive note, the dishwasher cleans better than the 7 year old Bosch model it replaces. However, it does not fit as many dishes as the old model.

When you finally have the options set, pressing the start button results in a beep, but upon closing the door the cycle doesn't start. If I open the door, press start again, and close the door, the dishwasher usually starts. Sometimes I must do this twice. The control panel also gets 'confused', where the light for every option is lit, but pressing the buttons has no effect. Pressing the Power/Reset button for several seconds sometimes clears this condition. Though it may require waiting several seconds and trying again. I am glad I bought the extended warranty from the dealer, since the electronics are sure to fail. I did install the Android 'Home Connect' smart phone app because it provides access to features not available on the control panel. As with many smart phone apps, the dishwasher app has a poor user interface and is not worth using (I have been a software developer for 40 years and find many apps and websites full of bugs).I was appaled that Bosch does NOT include a hardcopy owners manual with the dishwasher. Often, when you press a button on the electronic control panel. the function you try to set is not selected. When you finally have the options set, pressing the start button results in a beep, but upon closing the door the cycle doesn't start. If I open the door, press start again, and close the door, the dishwasher usually starts. Sometimes I must do this twice. The control panel also gets "confused", where the light for every option is lit, but pressing the buttons has no effect. Pressing the Power/Reset button for several seconds sometimes clears this condition. Though it may require waiting several seconds and trying again. I am glad I bought the extended warranty from the dealer, since the electronics are sure to fail. I did install the Android "Home Connect" smart phone app because it provides access to features not available on the control panel. As with many smart phone apps, the dishwasher app has a poor user interface and is not worth using (I have been a software developer for 40 years and find many apps and websites full of bugs). I was appaled that Bosch does NOT include a hardcopy owners manual with the dishwasher. It comes with an inadequate quick start guide. A "real" 40 page owner's manual can be downloaded from the website. Bosch should have included the full manual given that retail price is $1,319. On a positive note, the dishwasher cleans better than the 7 year old Bosch model it replaces. However, it does not fit as many dishes as the old model.

Comments (English): [ The item that gave me back my free time ] || ---------------- || I was thinking about things like a robot vacuum cleaner when I moved in, but a dishwasher was completely unexpected. Even though we're a family of three, the dad and son love their friends so much that there was always an abundance of dishes in the house, so I ended up buying one unexpectedly. When I moved and became a stay-at-home mom, my husband bought me a massage chair because he was tired, but I whined and said that I didn't have time for it because of the housework and dishes. Then I said that a dishwasher would be better, and my husband readily supported that idea. So I ordered it right away. I commend my perseverance. I wanted the green one, but it was about 100,000 won more expensive than the latest model, and I had a 2024 model, so I didn't really want to buy the more expensive 2020 model, so I went with this one with the rocket-mounted installation. After installing it, I think I like this color better. This is my first dishwasher, so it's a bit strange. I connected it to LG ThinQ and selected only the top wash function. I feel so good. It came out clean, and I can run the dishwasher and do other things, so I feel like I have more free time. ^^

Comments (English): [ I understand why everyone is telling me to buy it. ] || ---------------- || Before moving in, I had to coordinate with the interior designer, so even though the order and delivery date changed several times, they installed it on time. My own review. =====================================. This is the first time I've ever purchased a large appliance online. I've always gone to the store to buy it. I'm a country bumpkin. Who would have thought it would be this easy to buy online! Plus, I got an additional credit card discount. Honestly, the price difference between the official website and the store was huge. I hesitated for a moment when the 14-person model was released, but it was almost double the price of the 12-person model. Everyone around me advised me not to be greedy because the 12-person model was more than enough. I chose the model with a hot air dryer, no matter what. My kids are in elementary school, but they get sick often and are hospitalized often. One of them even insists on carrying a spoon and chopsticks around with him (he doesn't want to use the spoons and chopsticks provided by the school). At home, we're still using a bottle sterilizer. I wanted to get rid of it. Haha;;;. For a family of three, eating lightly with the kids without a husband, we only use the upper compartment. Even if we cook a main dish, it doesn't fill up too much. For a family of four, 12 people seems plenty roomy. The photo was taken when I was using the upper compartment. (There are no dishes in the lower compartment.) I'm still a dishwasher novice, so I'm not very good at Tetris with dishes, but I just roughly put them in. They say you can't put plastic in, but baby bottles, water bottles, and trash cans were fine. Oh, and before that, let's do some pre-washing. I rinsed out the rice paste and red pepper powder before putting them in! If you select the upper compartment, it will take a little over 2 hours, including the hot air drying time. The door will open slightly after washing and drying. (Models without hot air drying end here.) The hot air drying process starts for about an hour from here. If you don't want to use hot air drying, you can cancel it here, but I bought it to do this, so I didn't cancel it. The music starts and everything is done. I run the dishwasher and take a break~. Why is everyone telling me to buy it no matter what? You have to use it to know for sure! If I'm going to pre-wash, I might as well just wash the dishes~. You might think that, but dishes that I've used the dishwasher for are much better than those that I wash by hand. The dishes are shiny~. Even for pre-washing, just scrub with a stick brush and you're done. It's actually not difficult. I should've bought it a long time ago. It's so, so good^^. The end.

Comments (English): [ I understand why everyone is telling me to buy it. ] || ---------------- || Before moving in, I had to coordinate with the interior designer, so even though the order and delivery date changed several times, they installed it on time. My own review. =====================================. This is the first time I've ever purchased a large appliance online. I've always gone to the store to buy it. I'm a country bumpkin. Who would have thought it would be this easy to buy online! Plus, I got an additional credit card discount. Honestly, the price difference between the official website and the store was huge. I hesitated for a moment when the 14-person model was released, but it was almost double the price of the 12-person model. Everyone around me advised me not to be greedy because the 12-person model was more than enough. I chose the model with a hot air dryer, no matter what. My kids are in elementary school, but they get sick often and are hospitalized often. One of them even insists on carrying a spoon and chopsticks around with him (he doesn't want to use the spoons and chopsticks provided by the school). At home, we're still using a bottle sterilizer. I wanted to get rid of it. Haha;;;. For a family of three, eating lightly with the kids without a husband, we only use the upper compartment. Even if we cook a main dish, it doesn't fill up too much. For a family of four, 12 people seems plenty roomy. The photo was taken when I was using the upper compartment. (There are no dishes in the lower compartment.) I'm still a dishwasher novice, so I'm not very good at Tetris with dishes, but I just roughly put them in. They say you can't put plastic in, but baby bottles, water bottles, and trash cans were fine. Oh, and before that, let's do some pre-washing. I rinsed out the rice paste and red pepper powder before putting them in! If you select the upper compartment, it will take a little over 2 hours, including the hot air drying time. The door will open slightly after washing and drying. (Models without hot air drying end here.) The hot air drying process starts for about an hour from here. If you don't want to use hot air drying, you can cancel it here, but I bought it to do this, so I didn't cancel it. The music starts and everything is done. I run the dishwasher and take a break~. Why is everyone telling me to buy it no matter what? You have to use it to know for sure! If I'm going to pre-wash, I might as well just wash the dishes~. You might think that, but dishes that I've used the dishwasher for are much better than those that I wash by hand. The dishes are shiny~. Even for pre-washing, just scrub with a stick brush and you're done. It's actually not difficult. I should've bought it a long time ago. It's so, so good^^. The end.

I hesitated for a moment when the 14-person model was released, but it was almost double the price of the 12-person model. My kids are in elementary school, but they get sick often and are hospitalized often. Sentence (English): I run the dishwasher and take a break~. Why is everyone telling me to buy it no matter what?
Comments (English): [ I understand why everyone is telling me to buy it. ] || ---------------- || Before moving in, I had to coordinate with the interior designer, so even though the order and delivery date changed several times, they installed it on time. My own review. =====================================. This is the first time I've ever purchased a large appliance online. I've always gone to the store to buy it. I'm a country bumpkin. Who would have thought it would be this easy to buy online! Plus, I got an additional credit card discount. Honestly, the price difference between the official website and the store was huge. I hesitated for a moment when the 14-person model was released, but it was almost double the price of the 12-person model. Everyone around me advised me not to be greedy because the 12-person model was more than enough. I chose the model with a hot air dryer, no matter what. My kids are in elementary school, but they get sick often and are hospitalized often. One of them even insists on carrying a spoon and chopsticks around with him (he doesn't want to use the spoons and chopsticks provided by the school). At home, we're still using a bottle sterilizer. I wanted to get rid of it. Haha;;;. For a family of three, eating lightly with the kids without a husband, we only use the upper compartment. Even if we cook a main dish, it doesn't fill up too much. For a family of four, 12 people seems plenty roomy. The photo was taken when I was using the upper compartment. (There are no dishes in the lower compartment.) I'm still a dishwasher novice, so I'm not very good at Tetris with dishes, but I just roughly put them in. They say you can't put plastic in, but baby bottles, water bottles, and trash cans were fine. Oh, and before that, let's do some pre-washing. I rinsed out the rice paste and red pepper powder before putting them in! If you select the upper compartment, it will take a little over 2 hours, including the hot air drying time. The door will open slightly after washing and drying. (Models without hot air drying end here.) The hot air drying process starts for about an hour from here. If you don't want to use hot air drying, you can cancel it here, but I bought it to do this, so I didn't cancel it. The music starts and everything is done. I run the dishwasher and take a break~. Why is everyone telling me to buy it no matter what? You have to use it to know for sure! If I'm going to pre-wash, I might as well just wash the dishes~. You might think that, but dishes that I've used the dishwasher for are much better than those that I wash by hand. The dishes are shiny~. Even for pre-washing, just scrub with a stick brush and you're done. It's actually not difficult. I should've bought it a long time ago. It's so, so good^^. The end.

Sentence (English): Overall, I really love this dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ Great Product! ] || ---------------- || Overall, I really love this dishwasher! This was a serious upgrade from the much older unit I previously had. I also love how there are MULTIPLE places throughout the unit that spray water. That really ensures that every dish gets the attention it needs! I really enjoy the WiFi/smart feature as well! If you're like me, you always remember you need to start the dishwasher after you've left the house, and now that's no longer an issue. Overall, I give this dishwasher a 4/5 stars, and I do recommend it for anyone in the market for a new one!

Sentence (English): A good dishwasher overall; good capacity, quiet, and cleans well.
Comments (English): A good dishwasher overall; good capacity, quiet, and cleans well. The topmost, or third, rack is extremely shallow so is only useful for a small number of low-profile items – but it comes in handy from time to time. The dedicated jets for bottles and silverware are a welcome addition and contribute to the overall cleaning performance. The installation can be a bit frustrating due to the finicky leveling feet and poorly designed side-mount brackets, though this is a problem for many dishwashers. The app connectivity is a bit silly though being able to track number of cycles run and getting alerts when the current cycle completes is useful. It meets expectations and looks nice.

I would recommend that you do not place ladles on the top rack as they can sometimes hold excess water that I forget about resulting in if I open that rack too quickly water will fly out. I mean really, if my biggest complaint is that sometimes ( not all the time) I have to take a rag to the dishes to finish drying them, then the dishwasher is just fine.

I have a lot of Yetis that I use for my water and my husband's coffee. They are perfect for this. The ability to lower the cup rack is also awesome - however when we do this, we have an issue with our larger plates fitting without getting hit by the wheel. I think my only wish would be that you could choose the hardware color without an additional cost. I am fine with the brushed brass for now, but will be changing the hardware to brushed nickel on our double oven and the dishwasher once I am able to get the fridge to match.

Pros: 1. It's large and has a neat design! Compared to the existing 6-person one, it's more than twice as big, about three times as big, so it can hold a lot. 2. Since it's a high-end model, it has three trays. The regular model has two trays, but this is a three-tier product, and it's really nice because it includes a detailed space on the top where you can put various cutlery. A spoon basket is also included separately, so there are three trays and one basket in total. 3. The height of the trays can be adjusted, and the top tray, which raises the spoons, can be folded to one side, such as the left or right. It can be removed if you want. 4. The top and bottom can be washed separately. Since the dishwasher is big, I thought I would have to fill it up to the brim, but this one can be washed by separating the top and bottom? You can wash small and light dishes in the middle and heavy and large dishes at the bottom. It is so new and convenient that you can just turn the top or just separate the bottom to wash the dishes. I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! I have a baby who is just starting to run around, so I don’t have time to open, close, and press all the buttons and various machines. When I saw this, I thought the buttons were in the perfect place for a baby to press, and it has a locking function. If you press the two program and + reservation buttons on the right at the same time, the locking function is automatically set, so you can use it safely without worrying if the baby tries to press or pull it! This is really great praise~ >,< As expected, I was so happy that I kept pressing the lock function so hard ^^ 6. It can be stored. It can be stored for 72 hours after using the dishwasher. It's a bit of a hassle to take it out and put it away right away, so if you just press one button, it will effectively remove the smell even if you leave it. When you press the storage button, the light blinks to let you know that storage has started. 7. There is a washing reservation function. You can delay the operation of the product up to 24 hours. Since it delays by 1 hour each time you press it, it's good to turn it on before you go to bed, but wouldn't it be convenient to press it and go to sleep when you want to reserve a specific time in advance? 8. The UV function can be used in all courses, and if you press and hold the UV button for 3 seconds, you can also do a strong wash! 9. You can use it in detail with 8 different washing courses. From the general standard mode to the strong, eco mode, and quick wash for light dishes like glass that are easy to clean and do not need to be dried, there are various modes available. 10. The dishwasher tablet does not get caught. Oh, this is really true. Our 6-person dishwasher kept getting the tablet caught, and when I was excited to finish washing, I opened it, but the tablet was still there. I was embarrassed more than once. Maybe because it is bigger, this one does not get the tablet caught, which is great. Unlike the 6-person one, the lid opens forward, and this one opens and closes horizontally, so it feels safer. 11. This is the best part. It washes a large volume at once! This is why dryers and dishwashers are always included among items that improve the quality of life, but dishwashers are really revolutionary! It is so convenient because I can finish a large volume at once that I could not even dream of with a 6-person dishwasher! Koreans in particular use a lot of red pepper powder. The combination of red pepper powder and oil is really. Hahaha. It’s hard to wash them cleanly without hot water, but since the machine washes them so conveniently, I don’t have to struggle with getting oil on my hands, so it’s really, really good. It washes not only red pepper oil, but also stuck-on rice paste and seasoning really, really well! I feel so relieved ^^ They say that this is because the water is sprayed from the upper, middle, and lower three groups with a high temperature of about 75 degrees Celsius. Every time I see it, I’m amazed at how the dishwasher cleans even such detailed parts. 12. The dishes shine more when you use the dishwasher than when you just wash them, so they become sparkling. It’s also thanks to the rinse in the tablet dishwasher, but they shine more, and since they’re washed cleanly and UV-sterilized, they’re more hygienic, neat, and great. 13. It even dries automatically, so I’m really satisfied! Wow~! After washing, the automatic door opening function intelligently discharges moisture, and the powerful drying function that uses two turbo fans is great because it allows for strong drying. It is not completely dry the moment washing is complete, but it is great because there are no water stains compared to the one I used before after natural drying. 14. It is hygienic and easy to manage with an all-stainless steel inner tube + triple filtration filter! 15. It is definitely much quieter. My husband likes it because it is much quieter than the one he used ^^ Cons: It is not completely dry right after it is finished and needs natural drying time. Since it is for 12 people, it is quite large in size. Since I need enough space, I ended up doing an unexpected house cleaning before receiving it. ; ; Since it is an old house, the sink height is low, so I couldn't install it as a built-in, so I installed it as a stand. Instead, thanks to it, the kitchen is clean after a long time. Securing enough space before receiving it! Precautions Never open it while using it or after washing it. There is a risk of burns, so if you open it in the middle, you can get hurt by the hot steam. Be sure to use a dishwasher-specific detergent. Otherwise, it will not only not clean well, but it can also cause the machine to break down. Thanks to this, my personal time has increased and my quality of life has improved!
