Of course, I use it very well, but when I fill it with pots and dishes, it doesn't wash well, so it's a bit stressful, so I kept thinking that it would be nice to have a larger dishwasher, and I got a chance to try it out through the Coupang Experience Group, which was a great opportunity, so I bought it. Pros: 1. It's large and has a neat design! Compared to the existing 6-person one, it's more than twice as big, about three times as big, so it can hold a lot. 2. Since it's a high-end model, it has three trays. The regular model has two trays, but this is a three-tier product, and it's really nice because it includes a detailed space on the top where you can put various cutlery. A spoon basket is also included separately, so there are three trays and one basket in total. 3. The height of the trays can be adjusted, and the top tray, which raises the spoons, can be folded to one side, such as the left or right. It can be removed if you want. 4. The top and bottom can be washed separately. Since the dishwasher is big, I thought I would have to fill it up to the brim, but this one can be washed by separating the top and bottom? You can wash small and light dishes in the middle and heavy and large dishes at the bottom. It is so new and convenient that you can just turn the top or just separate the bottom to wash the dishes. I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! I have a baby who is just starting to run around, so I don’t have time to open, close, and press all the buttons and various machines. When I saw this, I thought the buttons were in the perfect place for a baby to press, and it has a locking function. If you press the two program and + reservation buttons on the right at the same time, the locking function is automatically set, so you can use it safely without worrying if the baby tries to press or pull it! This is really great praise~ >,< As expected, I was so happy that I kept pressing the lock function so hard ^^ 6. It can be stored. It can be stored for 72 hours after using the dishwasher. It's a bit of a hassle to take it out and put it away right away, so if you just press one button, it will effectively remove the smell even if you leave it. When you press the storage button, the light blinks to let you know that storage has started. 7. There is a washing reservation function. You can delay the operation of the product up to 24 hours. Since it delays by 1 hour each time you press it, it's good to turn it on before you go to bed, but wouldn't it be convenient to press it and go to sleep when you want to reserve a specific time in advance? 8. The UV function can be used in all courses, and if you press and hold the UV button for 3 seconds, you can also do a strong wash! 9. You can use it in detail with 8 different washing courses. From the general standard mode to the strong, eco mode, and quick wash for light dishes like glass that are easy to clean and do not need to be dried, there are various modes available. 10. The dishwasher tablet does not get caught. Oh, this is really true. Our 6-person dishwasher kept getting the tablet caught, and when I was excited to finish washing, I opened it, but the tablet was still there. I was embarrassed more than once. Maybe because it is bigger, this one does not get the tablet caught, which is great. Unlike the 6-person one, the lid opens forward, and this one opens and closes horizontally, so it feels safer. 11. This is the best part. It washes a large volume at once! This is why dryers and dishwashers are always included among items that improve the quality of life, but dishwashers are really revolutionary! It is so convenient because I can finish a large volume at once that I could not even dream of with a 6-person dishwasher! Koreans in particular use a lot of red pepper powder. The combination of red pepper powder and oil is really. Hahaha. It’s hard to wash them cleanly without hot water, but since the machine washes them so conveniently, I don’t have to struggle with getting oil on my hands, so it’s really, really good. It washes not only red pepper oil, but also stuck-on rice paste and seasoning really, really well! I feel so relieved ^^ They say that this is because the water is sprayed from the upper, middle, and lower three groups with a high temperature of about 75 degrees Celsius. Every time I see it, I’m amazed at how the dishwasher cleans even such detailed parts. 12. The dishes shine more when you use the dishwasher than when you just wash them, so they become sparkling. It’s also thanks to the rinse in the tablet dishwasher, but they shine more, and since they’re washed cleanly and UV-sterilized, they’re more hygienic, neat, and great. 13. It even dries automatically, so I’m really satisfied! Wow~! After washing, the automatic door opening function intelligently discharges moisture, and the powerful drying function that uses two turbo fans is great because it allows for strong drying. It is not completely dry the moment washing is complete, but it is great because there are no water stains compared to the one I used before after natural drying. 14. It is hygienic and easy to manage with an all-stainless steel inner tube + triple filtration filter! 15. It is definitely much quieter. My husband likes it because it is much quieter than the one he used ^^ Cons: It is not completely dry right after it is finished and needs natural drying time. Since it is for 12 people, it is quite large in size. Since I need enough space, I ended up doing an unexpected house cleaning before receiving it. ; ; Since it is an old house, the sink height is low, so I couldn't install it as a built-in, so I installed it as a stand. There is a risk of burns, so if you open it in the middle, you can get hurt by the hot steam. Be sure to use a dishwasher-specific detergent. Otherwise, it will not only not clean well, but it can also cause the machine to break down. Thanks to this, my personal time has increased and my quality of life has improved! I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! Pros: 1. It's large and has a neat design! Compared to the existing 6-person one, it's more than twice as big, about three times as big, so it can hold a lot. 2. Since it's a high-end model, it has three trays. The regular model has two trays, but this is a three-tier product, and it's really nice because it includes a detailed space on the top where you can put various cutlery. A spoon basket is also included separately, so there are three trays and one basket in total. 3. The height of the trays can be adjusted, and the top tray, which raises the spoons, can be folded to one side, such as the left or right. It can be removed if you want. 4. The top and bottom can be washed separately. Since the dishwasher is big, I thought I would have to fill it up to the brim, but this one can be washed by separating the top and bottom? You can wash small and light dishes in the middle and heavy and large dishes at the bottom. It is so new and convenient that you can just turn the top or just separate the bottom to wash the dishes. I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! I have a baby who is just starting to run around, so I don’t have time to open, close, and press all the buttons and various machines. When I saw this, I thought the buttons were in the perfect place for a baby to press, and it has a locking function. If you press the two program and + reservation buttons on the right at the same time, the locking function is automatically set, so you can use it safely without worrying if the baby tries to press or pull it! This is really great praise~ >,< As expected, I was so happy that I kept pressing the lock function so hard ^^ 6. It can be stored. It can be stored for 72 hours after using the dishwasher. Comments (English): [ The quality of life has improved with the large capacity washing machine. I really love it. ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase: I have a 6-person dishwasher at home, but since we have a large family, that size is not enough. Of course, I use it very well, but when I fill it with pots and dishes, it doesn't wash well, so it's a bit stressful, so I kept thinking that it would be nice to have a larger dishwasher, and I got a chance to try it out through the Coupang Experience Group, which was a great opportunity, so I bought it. Pros: 1. It's large and has a neat design! Compared to the existing 6-person one, it's more than twice as big, about three times as big, so it can hold a lot. 2. Since it's a high-end model, it has three trays. The regular model has two trays, but this is a three-tier product, and it's really nice because it includes a detailed space on the top where you can put various cutlery. A spoon basket is also included separately, so there are three trays and one basket in total. 3. The height of the trays can be adjusted, and the top tray, which raises the spoons, can be folded to one side, such as the left or right. It can be removed if you want. 4. The top and bottom can be washed separately. Since the dishwasher is big, I thought I would have to fill it up to the brim, but this one can be washed by separating the top and bottom? You can wash small and light dishes in the middle and heavy and large dishes at the bottom. It is so new and convenient that you can just turn the top or just separate the bottom to wash the dishes. I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! I have a baby who is just starting to run around, so I don’t have time to open, close, and press all the buttons and various machines. When I saw this, I thought the buttons were in the perfect place for a baby to press, and it has a locking function. If you press the two program and + reservation buttons on the right at the same time, the locking function is automatically set, so you can use it safely without worrying if the baby tries to press or pull it! This is really great praise~ >,< As expected, I was so happy that I kept pressing the lock function so hard ^^ 6. It can be stored. It can be stored for 72 hours after using the dishwasher. It's a bit of a hassle to take it out and put it away right away, so if you just press one button, it will effectively remove the smell even if you leave it. When you press the storage button, the light blinks to let you know that storage has started. 7. There is a washing reservation function. You can delay the operation of the product up to 24 hours. Since it delays by 1 hour each time you press it, it's good to turn it on before you go to bed, but wouldn't it be convenient to press it and go to sleep when you want to reserve a specific time in advance? 8. The UV function can be used in all courses, and if you press and hold the UV button for 3 seconds, you can also do a strong wash! 9. You can use it in detail with 8 different washing courses. From the general standard mode to the strong, eco mode, and quick wash for light dishes like glass that are easy to clean and do not need to be dried, there are various modes available. 10. The dishwasher tablet does not get caught. Oh, this is really true. Our 6-person dishwasher kept getting the tablet caught, and when I was excited to finish washing, I opened it, but the tablet was still there. I was embarrassed more than once. Maybe because it is bigger, this one does not get the tablet caught, which is great. Unlike the 6-person one, the lid opens forward, and this one opens and closes horizontally, so it feels safer. 11. This is the best part. It washes a large volume at once! This is why dryers and dishwashers are always included among items that improve the quality of life, but dishwashers are really revolutionary! It is so convenient because I can finish a large volume at once that I could not even dream of with a 6-person dishwasher! Koreans in particular use a lot of red pepper powder. The combination of red pepper powder and oil is really. Hahaha. It’s hard to wash them cleanly without hot water, but since the machine washes them so conveniently, I don’t have to struggle with getting oil on my hands, so it’s really, really good. It washes not only red pepper oil, but also stuck-on rice paste and seasoning really, really well! I feel so relieved ^^ They say that this is because the water is sprayed from the upper, middle, and lower three groups with a high temperature of about 75 degrees Celsius. Every time I see it, I’m amazed at how the dishwasher cleans even such detailed parts. 12. The dishes shine more when you use the dishwasher than when you just wash them, so they become sparkling. It’s also thanks to the rinse in the tablet dishwasher, but they shine more, and since they’re washed cleanly and UV-sterilized, they’re more hygienic, neat, and great. 13. It even dries automatically, so I’m really satisfied! Wow~! After washing, the automatic door opening function intelligently discharges moisture, and the powerful drying function that uses two turbo fans is great because it allows for strong drying. It is not completely dry the moment washing is complete, but it is great because there are no water stains compared to the one I used before after natural drying. 14. It is hygienic and easy to manage with an all-stainless steel inner tube + triple filtration filter! 15. It is definitely much quieter. My husband likes it because it is much quieter than the one he used ^^ Cons: It is not completely dry right after it is finished and needs natural drying time. Since it is for 12 people, it is quite large in size. Since I need enough space, I ended up doing an unexpected house cleaning before receiving it. ; ; Since it is an old house, the sink height is low, so I couldn't install it as a built-in, so I installed it as a stand. Instead, thanks to it, the kitchen is clean after a long time. Securing enough space before receiving it! Precautions Never open it while using it or after washing it. There is a risk of burns, so if you open it in the middle, you can get hurt by the hot steam. Be sure to use a dishwasher-specific detergent. Otherwise, it will not only not clean well, but it can also cause the machine to break down. Thanks to this, my personal time has increased and my quality of life has improved! I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! I really love it. ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase: I have a 6-person dishwasher at home, but since we have a large family, that size is not enough. Of course, I use it very well, but when I fill it with pots and dishes, it doesn't wash well, so it's a bit stressful, so I kept thinking that it would be nice to have a larger dishwasher, and I got a chance to try it out through the Coupang Experience Group, which was a great opportunity, so I bought it. Pros: 1. It's large and has a neat design! Compared to the existing 6-person one, it's more than twice as big, about three times as big, so it can hold a lot. 2. Since it's a high-end model, it has three trays. The regular model has two trays, but this is a three-tier product, and it's really nice because it includes a detailed space on the top where you can put various cutlery. A spoon basket is also included separately, so there are three trays and one basket in total. 3. The height of the trays can be adjusted, and the top tray, which raises the spoons, can be folded to one side, such as the left or right. It can be removed if you want. 4. The top and bottom can be washed separately. Since the dishwasher is big, I thought I would have to fill it up to the brim, but this one can be washed by separating the top and bottom? You can wash small and light dishes in the middle and heavy and large dishes at the bottom. It is so new and convenient that you can just turn the top or just separate the bottom to wash the dishes. I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! I have a baby who is just starting to run around, so I don’t have time to open, close, and press all the buttons and various machines. When I saw this, I thought the buttons were in the perfect place for a baby to press, and it has a locking function. If you press the two program and + reservation buttons on the right at the same time, the locking function is automatically set, so you can use it safely without worrying if the baby tries to press or pull it! This is really great praise~ >,< As expected, I was so happy that I kept pressing the lock function so hard ^^ 6. It can be stored. It can be stored for 72 hours after using the dishwasher. It's a bit of a hassle to take it out and put it away right away, so if you just press one button, it will effectively remove the smell even if you leave it. When you press the storage button, the light blinks to let you know that storage has started. 7. There is a washing reservation function. You can delay the operation of the product up to 24 hours. Since it delays by 1 hour each time you press it, it's good to turn it on before you go to bed, but wouldn't it be convenient to press it and go to sleep when you want to reserve a specific time in advance? 8. The UV function can be used in all courses, and if you press and hold the UV button for 3 seconds, you can also do a strong wash! 9. You can use it in detail with 8 different washing courses. From the general standard mode to the strong, eco mode, and quick wash for light dishes like glass that are easy to clean and do not need to be dried, there are various modes available. 10. The dishwasher tablet does not get caught. Oh, this is really true. Our 6-person dishwasher kept getting the tablet caught, and when I was excited to finish washing, I opened it, but the tablet was still there. I was embarrassed more than once. Maybe because it is bigger, this one does not get the tablet caught, which is great. Unlike the 6-person one, the lid opens forward, and this one opens and closes horizontally, so it feels safer. 11. This is the best part. It washes a large volume at once! This is why dryers and dishwashers are always included among items that improve the quality of life, but dishwashers are really revolutionary! It is so convenient because I can finish a large volume at once that I could not even dream of with a 6-person dishwasher! Koreans in particular use a lot of red pepper powder. The combination of red pepper powder and oil is really. Hahaha. It’s hard to wash them cleanly without hot water, but since the machine washes them so conveniently, I don’t have to struggle with getting oil on my hands, so it’s really, really good. It washes not only red pepper oil, but also stuck-on rice paste and seasoning really, really well! I feel so relieved ^^ They say that this is because the water is sprayed from the upper, middle, and lower three groups with a high temperature of about 75 degrees Celsius. Every time I see it, I’m amazed at how the dishwasher cleans even such detailed parts. 12. The dishes shine more when you use the dishwasher than when you just wash them, so they become sparkling. It even dries automatically, so I’m really satisfied! Wow~! After washing, the automatic door opening function intelligently discharges moisture, and the powerful drying function that uses two turbo fans is great because it allows for strong drying. It is not completely dry the moment washing is complete, but it is great because there are no water stains compared to the one I used before after natural drying. 14. It is hygienic and easy to manage with an all-stainless steel inner tube + triple filtration filter! 15. It is definitely much quieter. You can wash small and light dishes in the middle and heavy and large dishes at the bottom. It is so new and convenient that you can just turn the top or just separate the bottom to wash the dishes. I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! I have a baby who is just starting to run around, so I don’t have time to open, close, and press all the buttons and various machines. When I saw this, I thought the buttons were in the perfect place for a baby to press, and it has a locking function. If you press the two program and + reservation buttons on the right at the same time, the locking function is automatically set, so you can use it safely without worrying if the baby tries to press or pull it! I really love it. ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase: I have a 6-person dishwasher at home, but since we have a large family, that size is not enough. Of course, I use it very well, but when I fill it with pots and dishes, it doesn't wash well, so it's a bit stressful, so I kept thinking that it would be nice to have a larger dishwasher, and I got a chance to try it out through the Coupang Experience Group, which was a great opportunity, so I bought it. Pros: 1. It's large and has a neat design! Compared to the existing 6-person one, it's more than twice as big, about three times as big, so it can hold a lot. 2. Since it's a high-end model, it has three trays. The regular model has two trays, but this is a three-tier product, and it's really nice because it includes a detailed space on the top where you can put various cutlery. A spoon basket is also included separately, so there are three trays and one basket in total. 3. The height of the trays can be adjusted, and the top tray, which raises the spoons, can be folded to one side, such as the left or right. It can be removed if you want. 4. The top and bottom can be washed separately. Since the dishwasher is big, I thought I would have to fill it up to the brim, but this one can be washed by separating the top and bottom? You can wash small and light dishes in the middle and heavy and large dishes at the bottom. It is so new and convenient that you can just turn the top or just separate the bottom to wash the dishes. I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! I have a baby who is just starting to run around, so I don’t have time to open, close, and press all the buttons and various machines. When I saw this, I thought the buttons were in the perfect place for a baby to press, and it has a locking function. If you press the two program and + reservation buttons on the right at the same time, the locking function is automatically set, so you can use it safely without worrying if the baby tries to press or pull it! This is really great praise~ >,< As expected, I was so happy that I kept pressing the lock function so hard ^^ 6. It can be stored. It can be stored for 72 hours after using the dishwasher. Since it delays by 1 hour each time you press it, it's good to turn it on before you go to bed, but wouldn't it be convenient to press it and go to sleep when you want to reserve a specific time in advance? 8. The UV function can be used in all courses, and if you press and hold the UV button for 3 seconds, you can also do a strong wash! 9. You can use it in detail with 8 different washing courses. From the general standard mode to the strong, eco mode, and quick wash for light dishes like glass that are easy to clean and do not need to be dried, there are various modes available. 10. The dishwasher tablet does not get caught. Oh, this is really true. Maybe because it is bigger, this one does not get the tablet caught, which is great. Unlike the 6-person one, the lid opens forward, and this one opens and closes horizontally, so it feels safer. 11. This is the best part. It washes a large volume at once! This is why dryers and dishwashers are always included among items that improve the quality of life, but dishwashers are really revolutionary! It is so convenient because I can finish a large volume at once that I could not even dream of with a 6-person dishwasher! Koreans in particular use a lot of red pepper powder. The combination of red pepper powder and oil is really. Hahaha. It’s hard to wash them cleanly without hot water, but since the machine washes them so conveniently, I don’t have to struggle with getting oil on my hands, so it’s really, really good. It washes not only red pepper oil, but also stuck-on rice paste and seasoning really, really well! I feel so relieved ^^ They say that this is because the water is sprayed from the upper, middle, and lower three groups with a high temperature of about 75 degrees Celsius. It even dries automatically, so I’m really satisfied! Wow~! After washing, the automatic door opening function intelligently discharges moisture, and the powerful drying function that uses two turbo fans is great because it allows for strong drying. It is not completely dry the moment washing is complete, but it is great because there are no water stains compared to the one I used before after natural drying. 14. I really love it. ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase: I have a 6-person dishwasher at home, but since we have a large family, that size is not enough. Pros: 1. It's large and has a neat design! Compared to the existing 6-person one, it's more than twice as big, about three times as big, so it can hold a lot. 2. Since it's a high-end model, it has three trays. The regular model has two trays, but this is a three-tier product, and it's really nice because it includes a detailed space on the top where you can put various cutlery. A spoon basket is also included separately, so there are three trays and one basket in total. 3. The height of the trays can be adjusted, and the top tray, which raises the spoons, can be folded to one side, such as the left or right. It can be removed if you want. 4. The top and bottom can be washed separately. Since the dishwasher is big, I thought I would have to fill it up to the brim, but this one can be washed by separating the top and bottom? You can wash small and light dishes in the middle and heavy and large dishes at the bottom. It is so new and convenient that you can just turn the top or just separate the bottom to wash the dishes. I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! I have a baby who is just starting to run around, so I don’t have time to open, close, and press all the buttons and various machines. When I saw this, I thought the buttons were in the perfect place for a baby to press, and it has a locking function. If you press the two program and + reservation buttons on the right at the same time, the locking function is automatically set, so you can use it safely without worrying if the baby tries to press or pull it! This is really great praise~ >,< As expected, I was so happy that I kept pressing the lock function so hard ^^ 6. It can be stored. It can be stored for 72 hours after using the dishwasher. It's a bit of a hassle to take it out and put it away right away, so if you just press one button, it will effectively remove the smell even if you leave it. Since it delays by 1 hour each time you press it, it's good to turn it on before you go to bed, but wouldn't it be convenient to press it and go to sleep when you want to reserve a specific time in advance? 8. The UV function can be used in all courses, and if you press and hold the UV button for 3 seconds, you can also do a strong wash! 9. You can use it in detail with 8 different washing courses. From the general standard mode to the strong, eco mode, and quick wash for light dishes like glass that are easy to clean and do not need to be dried, there are various modes available. 10. The dishwasher tablet does not get caught. Oh, this is really true. Our 6-person dishwasher kept getting the tablet caught, and when I was excited to finish washing, I opened it, but the tablet was still there. I was embarrassed more than once. Maybe because it is bigger, this one does not get the tablet caught, which is great. Unlike the 6-person one, the lid opens forward, and this one opens and closes horizontally, so it feels safer. 11. This is the best part. It washes a large volume at once! This is why dryers and dishwashers are always included among items that improve the quality of life, but dishwashers are really revolutionary! It is so convenient because I can finish a large volume at once that I could not even dream of with a 6-person dishwasher! Koreans in particular use a lot of red pepper powder. The combination of red pepper powder and oil is really. Hahaha. It washes not only red pepper oil, but also stuck-on rice paste and seasoning really, really well! It even dries automatically, so I’m really satisfied! Wow~! You can wash small and light dishes in the middle and heavy and large dishes at the bottom. It is so new and convenient that you can just turn the top or just separate the bottom to wash the dishes. I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! When I saw this, I thought the buttons were in the perfect place for a baby to press, and it has a locking function. I really love it. ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase: I have a 6-person dishwasher at home, but since we have a large family, that size is not enough. Pros: 1. It's large and has a neat design! Compared to the existing 6-person one, it's more than twice as big, about three times as big, so it can hold a lot. 2. Since it's a high-end model, it has three trays. The regular model has two trays, but this is a three-tier product, and it's really nice because it includes a detailed space on the top where you can put various cutlery. A spoon basket is also included separately, so there are three trays and one basket in total. 3. The height of the trays can be adjusted, and the top tray, which raises the spoons, can be folded to one side, such as the left or right. It can be removed if you want. 4. The top and bottom can be washed separately. Since the dishwasher is big, I thought I would have to fill it up to the brim, but this one can be washed by separating the top and bottom? You can wash small and light dishes in the middle and heavy and large dishes at the bottom. It is so new and convenient that you can just turn the top or just separate the bottom to wash the dishes. I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! I have a baby who is just starting to run around, so I don’t have time to open, close, and press all the buttons and various machines. When I saw this, I thought the buttons were in the perfect place for a baby to press, and it has a locking function. If you press the two program and + reservation buttons on the right at the same time, the locking function is automatically set, so you can use it safely without worrying if the baby tries to press or pull it! This is really great praise~ >,< As expected, I was so happy that I kept pressing the lock function so hard ^^ 6. It can be stored. It can be stored for 72 hours after using the dishwasher. The UV function can be used in all courses, and if you press and hold the UV button for 3 seconds, you can also do a strong wash! 9. You can use it in detail with 8 different washing courses. The dishwasher tablet does not get caught. Oh, this is really true. This is the best part. It washes a large volume at once! This is why dryers and dishwashers are always included among items that improve the quality of life, but dishwashers are really revolutionary! Comments (English): [ The quality of life has improved with the large capacity washing machine. I really love it. ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase: I have a 6-person dishwasher at home, but since we have a large family, that size is not enough. Of course, I use it very well, but when I fill it with pots and dishes, it doesn't wash well, so it's a bit stressful, so I kept thinking that it would be nice to have a larger dishwasher, and I got a chance to try it out through the Coupang Experience Group, which was a great opportunity, so I bought it. Pros: 1. It's large and has a neat design! Compared to the existing 6-person one, it's more than twice as big, about three times as big, so it can hold a lot. 2. Since it's a high-end model, it has three trays. The regular model has two trays, but this is a three-tier product, and it's really nice because it includes a detailed space on the top where you can put various cutlery. A spoon basket is also included separately, so there are three trays and one basket in total. 3. The height of the trays can be adjusted, and the top tray, which raises the spoons, can be folded to one side, such as the left or right. It can be removed if you want. 4. The top and bottom can be washed separately. Since the dishwasher is big, I thought I would have to fill it up to the brim, but this one can be washed by separating the top and bottom? You can wash small and light dishes in the middle and heavy and large dishes at the bottom. It is so new and convenient that you can just turn the top or just separate the bottom to wash the dishes. I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! I have a baby who is just starting to run around, so I don’t have time to open, close, and press all the buttons and various machines. When I saw this, I thought the buttons were in the perfect place for a baby to press, and it has a locking function. If you press the two program and + reservation buttons on the right at the same time, the locking function is automatically set, so you can use it safely without worrying if the baby tries to press or pull it! This is really great praise~ >,< As expected, I was so happy that I kept pressing the lock function so hard ^^ 6. It can be stored. It can be stored for 72 hours after using the dishwasher. It's a bit of a hassle to take it out and put it away right away, so if you just press one button, it will effectively remove the smell even if you leave it. When you press the storage button, the light blinks to let you know that storage has started. 7. There is a washing reservation function. You can delay the operation of the product up to 24 hours. Since it delays by 1 hour each time you press it, it's good to turn it on before you go to bed, but wouldn't it be convenient to press it and go to sleep when you want to reserve a specific time in advance? 8. The UV function can be used in all courses, and if you press and hold the UV button for 3 seconds, you can also do a strong wash! 9. You can use it in detail with 8 different washing courses. From the general standard mode to the strong, eco mode, and quick wash for light dishes like glass that are easy to clean and do not need to be dried, there are various modes available. 10. The dishwasher tablet does not get caught. Oh, this is really true. Our 6-person dishwasher kept getting the tablet caught, and when I was excited to finish washing, I opened it, but the tablet was still there. I was embarrassed more than once. Maybe because it is bigger, this one does not get the tablet caught, which is great. Unlike the 6-person one, the lid opens forward, and this one opens and closes horizontally, so it feels safer. 11. This is the best part. It washes a large volume at once! This is why dryers and dishwashers are always included among items that improve the quality of life, but dishwashers are really revolutionary! It is so convenient because I can finish a large volume at once that I could not even dream of with a 6-person dishwasher! Koreans in particular use a lot of red pepper powder. The combination of red pepper powder and oil is really. Hahaha. It’s hard to wash them cleanly without hot water, but since the machine washes them so conveniently, I don’t have to struggle with getting oil on my hands, so it’s really, really good. It washes not only red pepper oil, but also stuck-on rice paste and seasoning really, really well! I feel so relieved ^^ They say that this is because the water is sprayed from the upper, middle, and lower three groups with a high temperature of about 75 degrees Celsius. Every time I see it, I’m amazed at how the dishwasher cleans even such detailed parts. 12. The dishes shine more when you use the dishwasher than when you just wash them, so they become sparkling. It’s also thanks to the rinse in the tablet dishwasher, but they shine more, and since they’re washed cleanly and UV-sterilized, they’re more hygienic, neat, and great. 13. It even dries automatically, so I’m really satisfied! Wow~! After washing, the automatic door opening function intelligently discharges moisture, and the powerful drying function that uses two turbo fans is great because it allows for strong drying. It is not completely dry the moment washing is complete, but it is great because there are no water stains compared to the one I used before after natural drying. 14. It is hygienic and easy to manage with an all-stainless steel inner tube + triple filtration filter! 15. It is definitely much quieter. My husband likes it because it is much quieter than the one he used ^^ Cons: It is not completely dry right after it is finished and needs natural drying time. Since it is for 12 people, it is quite large in size. Since I need enough space, I ended up doing an unexpected house cleaning before receiving it. ; ; Since it is an old house, the sink height is low, so I couldn't install it as a built-in, so I installed it as a stand. Instead, thanks to it, the kitchen is clean after a long time. Securing enough space before receiving it! Precautions Never open it while using it or after washing it. There is a risk of burns, so if you open it in the middle, you can get hurt by the hot steam. Be sure to use a dishwasher-specific detergent. Otherwise, it will not only not clean well, but it can also cause the machine to break down. Thanks to this, my personal time has increased and my quality of life has improved! I am really very satisfied with it. I should have bought a bigger one sooner. Oh, by the way, we installed it a little higher than the built-in one, so there was an additional fee. I really love it. ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase: I have a 6-person dishwasher at home, but since we have a large family, that size is not enough. Of course, I use it very well, but when I fill it with pots and dishes, it doesn't wash well, so it's a bit stressful, so I kept thinking that it would be nice to have a larger dishwasher, and I got a chance to try it out through the Coupang Experience Group, which was a great opportunity, so I bought it. Pros: 1. It's large and has a neat design! Compared to the existing 6-person one, it's more than twice as big, about three times as big, so it can hold a lot. 2. Since it's a high-end model, it has three trays. The regular model has two trays, but this is a three-tier product, and it's really nice because it includes a detailed space on the top where you can put various cutlery. A spoon basket is also included separately, so there are three trays and one basket in total. 3. The height of the trays can be adjusted, and the top tray, which raises the spoons, can be folded to one side, such as the left or right. It can be removed if you want. 4. The top and bottom can be washed separately. Since the dishwasher is big, I thought I would have to fill it up to the brim, but this one can be washed by separating the top and bottom? You can wash small and light dishes in the middle and heavy and large dishes at the bottom. It is so new and convenient that you can just turn the top or just separate the bottom to wash the dishes. I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! I have a baby who is just starting to run around, so I don’t have time to open, close, and press all the buttons and various machines. When I saw this, I thought the buttons were in the perfect place for a baby to press, and it has a locking function. If you press the two program and + reservation buttons on the right at the same time, the locking function is automatically set, so you can use it safely without worrying if the baby tries to press or pull it! This is really great praise~ >,< As expected, I was so happy that I kept pressing the lock function so hard ^^ 6. It can be stored. It can be stored for 72 hours after using the dishwasher. It's a bit of a hassle to take it out and put it away right away, so if you just press one button, it will effectively remove the smell even if you leave it. When you press the storage button, the light blinks to let you know that storage has started. 7. There is a washing reservation function. You can delay the operation of the product up to 24 hours. Since it delays by 1 hour each time you press it, it's good to turn it on before you go to bed, but wouldn't it be convenient to press it and go to sleep when you want to reserve a specific time in advance? 8. The UV function can be used in all courses, and if you press and hold the UV button for 3 seconds, you can also do a strong wash! 9. You can use it in detail with 8 different washing courses. From the general standard mode to the strong, eco mode, and quick wash for light dishes like glass that are easy to clean and do not need to be dried, there are various modes available. 10. The dishwasher tablet does not get caught. Oh, this is really true. Our 6-person dishwasher kept getting the tablet caught, and when I was excited to finish washing, I opened it, but the tablet was still there. I was embarrassed more than once. Maybe because it is bigger, this one does not get the tablet caught, which is great. Unlike the 6-person one, the lid opens forward, and this one opens and closes horizontally, so it feels safer. 11. This is the best part. It washes a large volume at once! This is why dryers and dishwashers are always included among items that improve the quality of life, but dishwashers are really revolutionary! It is so convenient because I can finish a large volume at once that I could not even dream of with a 6-person dishwasher! Koreans in particular use a lot of red pepper powder. The combination of red pepper powder and oil is really. Hahaha. It’s hard to wash them cleanly without hot water, but since the machine washes them so conveniently, I don’t have to struggle with getting oil on my hands, so it’s really, really good. It washes not only red pepper oil, but also stuck-on rice paste and seasoning really, really well! I feel so relieved ^^ They say that this is because the water is sprayed from the upper, middle, and lower three groups with a high temperature of about 75 degrees Celsius. Every time I see it, I’m amazed at how the dishwasher cleans even such detailed parts. 12. The dishes shine more when you use the dishwasher than when you just wash them, so they become sparkling. It’s also thanks to the rinse in the tablet dishwasher, but they shine more, and since they’re washed cleanly and UV-sterilized, they’re more hygienic, neat, and great. 13. It even dries automatically, so I’m really satisfied! Wow~! After washing, the automatic door opening function intelligently discharges moisture, and the powerful drying function that uses two turbo fans is great because it allows for strong drying. It is not completely dry the moment washing is complete, but it is great because there are no water stains compared to the one I used before after natural drying. 14. It is hygienic and easy to manage with an all-stainless steel inner tube + triple filtration filter! 15. It is definitely much quieter. Since it is for 12 people, it is quite large in size. I really love it. ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase: I have a 6-person dishwasher at home, but since we have a large family, that size is not enough. Of course, I use it very well, but when I fill it with pots and dishes, it doesn't wash well, so it's a bit stressful, so I kept thinking that it would be nice to have a larger dishwasher, and I got a chance to try it out through the Coupang Experience Group, which was a great opportunity, so I bought it. Pros: 1. It's large and has a neat design! Compared to the existing 6-person one, it's more than twice as big, about three times as big, so it can hold a lot. 2. Since it's a high-end model, it has three trays. The regular model has two trays, but this is a three-tier product, and it's really nice because it includes a detailed space on the top where you can put various cutlery. A spoon basket is also included separately, so there are three trays and one basket in total. 3. The height of the trays can be adjusted, and the top tray, which raises the spoons, can be folded to one side, such as the left or right. It can be removed if you want. 4. The top and bottom can be washed separately. Since the dishwasher is big, I thought I would have to fill it up to the brim, but this one can be washed by separating the top and bottom? You can wash small and light dishes in the middle and heavy and large dishes at the bottom. It is so new and convenient that you can just turn the top or just separate the bottom to wash the dishes. I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! I have a baby who is just starting to run around, so I don’t have time to open, close, and press all the buttons and various machines. When I saw this, I thought the buttons were in the perfect place for a baby to press, and it has a locking function. If you press the two program and + reservation buttons on the right at the same time, the locking function is automatically set, so you can use it safely without worrying if the baby tries to press or pull it! This is really great praise~ >,< As expected, I was so happy that I kept pressing the lock function so hard ^^ 6. It can be stored. It can be stored for 72 hours after using the dishwasher. It's a bit of a hassle to take it out and put it away right away, so if you just press one button, it will effectively remove the smell even if you leave it. When you press the storage button, the light blinks to let you know that storage has started. 7. There is a washing reservation function. You can delay the operation of the product up to 24 hours. Since it delays by 1 hour each time you press it, it's good to turn it on before you go to bed, but wouldn't it be convenient to press it and go to sleep when you want to reserve a specific time in advance? 8. The UV function can be used in all courses, and if you press and hold the UV button for 3 seconds, you can also do a strong wash! 9. You can use it in detail with 8 different washing courses. From the general standard mode to the strong, eco mode, and quick wash for light dishes like glass that are easy to clean and do not need to be dried, there are various modes available. 10. The dishwasher tablet does not get caught. Oh, this is really true. Our 6-person dishwasher kept getting the tablet caught, and when I was excited to finish washing, I opened it, but the tablet was still there. I was embarrassed more than once. Maybe because it is bigger, this one does not get the tablet caught, which is great. Unlike the 6-person one, the lid opens forward, and this one opens and closes horizontally, so it feels safer. 11. This is the best part. It washes a large volume at once! This is why dryers and dishwashers are always included among items that improve the quality of life, but dishwashers are really revolutionary! It is so convenient because I can finish a large volume at once that I could not even dream of with a 6-person dishwasher! Koreans in particular use a lot of red pepper powder. The combination of red pepper powder and oil is really. Hahaha. It’s hard to wash them cleanly without hot water, but since the machine washes them so conveniently, I don’t have to struggle with getting oil on my hands, so it’s really, really good. It washes not only red pepper oil, but also stuck-on rice paste and seasoning really, really well! I feel so relieved ^^ They say that this is because the water is sprayed from the upper, middle, and lower three groups with a high temperature of about 75 degrees Celsius. Every time I see it, I’m amazed at how the dishwasher cleans even such detailed parts. 12. The dishes shine more when you use the dishwasher than when you just wash them, so they become sparkling. It’s also thanks to the rinse in the tablet dishwasher, but they shine more, and since they’re washed cleanly and UV-sterilized, they’re more hygienic, neat, and great. 13. It even dries automatically, so I’m really satisfied! Wow~! After washing, the automatic door opening function intelligently discharges moisture, and the powerful drying function that uses two turbo fans is great because it allows for strong drying. It is not completely dry the moment washing is complete, but it is great because there are no water stains compared to the one I used before after natural drying. 14. It is hygienic and easy to manage with an all-stainless steel inner tube + triple filtration filter! 15. It is definitely much quieter. Since it is for 12 people, it is quite large in size. I really love it. ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase: I have a 6-person dishwasher at home, but since we have a large family, that size is not enough. Pros: 1. It's large and has a neat design! Compared to the existing 6-person one, it's more than twice as big, about three times as big, so it can hold a lot. 2. Since it's a high-end model, it has three trays. The regular model has two trays, but this is a three-tier product, and it's really nice because it includes a detailed space on the top where you can put various cutlery. A spoon basket is also included separately, so there are three trays and one basket in total. 3. The height of the trays can be adjusted, and the top tray, which raises the spoons, can be folded to one side, such as the left or right. It can be removed if you want. 4. The top and bottom can be washed separately. Since the dishwasher is big, I thought I would have to fill it up to the brim, but this one can be washed by separating the top and bottom? You can wash small and light dishes in the middle and heavy and large dishes at the bottom. It is so new and convenient that you can just turn the top or just separate the bottom to wash the dishes. I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! I have a baby who is just starting to run around, so I don’t have time to open, close, and press all the buttons and various machines. When I saw this, I thought the buttons were in the perfect place for a baby to press, and it has a locking function. If you press the two program and + reservation buttons on the right at the same time, the locking function is automatically set, so you can use it safely without worrying if the baby tries to press or pull it! This is really great praise~ >,< As expected, I was so happy that I kept pressing the lock function so hard ^^ 6. It can be stored. It can be stored for 72 hours after using the dishwasher. It's a bit of a hassle to take it out and put it away right away, so if you just press one button, it will effectively remove the smell even if you leave it. When you press the storage button, the light blinks to let you know that storage has started. 7. There is a washing reservation function. You can delay the operation of the product up to 24 hours. The UV function can be used in all courses, and if you press and hold the UV button for 3 seconds, you can also do a strong wash! 9. You can use it in detail with 8 different washing courses. The dishwasher tablet does not get caught. Oh, this is really true. The combination of red pepper powder and oil is really. Hahaha. You can wash small and light dishes in the middle and heavy and large dishes at the bottom. It is so new and convenient that you can just turn the top or just separate the bottom to wash the dishes. I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! When I saw this, I thought the buttons were in the perfect place for a baby to press, and it has a locking function. I really love it. ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase: I have a 6-person dishwasher at home, but since we have a large family, that size is not enough. A spoon basket is also included separately, so there are three trays and one basket in total. 3. The height of the trays can be adjusted, and the top tray, which raises the spoons, can be folded to one side, such as the left or right. It can be removed if you want. 4. The top and bottom can be washed separately. Since the dishwasher is big, I thought I would have to fill it up to the brim, but this one can be washed by separating the top and bottom? You can wash small and light dishes in the middle and heavy and large dishes at the bottom. It is so new and convenient that you can just turn the top or just separate the bottom to wash the dishes. I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! I have a baby who is just starting to run around, so I don’t have time to open, close, and press all the buttons and various machines. When I saw this, I thought the buttons were in the perfect place for a baby to press, and it has a locking function. If you press the two program and + reservation buttons on the right at the same time, the locking function is automatically set, so you can use it safely without worrying if the baby tries to press or pull it! This is really great praise~ >,< As expected, I was so happy that I kept pressing the lock function so hard ^^ 6. It can be stored. It can be stored for 72 hours after using the dishwasher. Comments (English): [ The quality of life has improved with the large capacity washing machine. I really love it. ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase: I have a 6-person dishwasher at home, but since we have a large family, that size is not enough. Of course, I use it very well, but when I fill it with pots and dishes, it doesn't wash well, so it's a bit stressful, so I kept thinking that it would be nice to have a larger dishwasher, and I got a chance to try it out through the Coupang Experience Group, which was a great opportunity, so I bought it. Pros: 1. It's large and has a neat design! Compared to the existing 6-person one, it's more than twice as big, about three times as big, so it can hold a lot. 2. Since it's a high-end model, it has three trays. The regular model has two trays, but this is a three-tier product, and it's really nice because it includes a detailed space on the top where you can put various cutlery. A spoon basket is also included separately, so there are three trays and one basket in total. 3. The height of the trays can be adjusted, and the top tray, which raises the spoons, can be folded to one side, such as the left or right. It can be removed if you want. 4. The top and bottom can be washed separately. Since the dishwasher is big, I thought I would have to fill it up to the brim, but this one can be washed by separating the top and bottom? You can wash small and light dishes in the middle and heavy and large dishes at the bottom. It is so new and convenient that you can just turn the top or just separate the bottom to wash the dishes. I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! I have a baby who is just starting to run around, so I don’t have time to open, close, and press all the buttons and various machines. When I saw this, I thought the buttons were in the perfect place for a baby to press, and it has a locking function. If you press the two program and + reservation buttons on the right at the same time, the locking function is automatically set, so you can use it safely without worrying if the baby tries to press or pull it! This is really great praise~ >,< As expected, I was so happy that I kept pressing the lock function so hard ^^ 6. It can be stored. It can be stored for 72 hours after using the dishwasher. It's a bit of a hassle to take it out and put it away right away, so if you just press one button, it will effectively remove the smell even if you leave it. When you press the storage button, the light blinks to let you know that storage has started. 7. There is a washing reservation function. You can delay the operation of the product up to 24 hours. Since it delays by 1 hour each time you press it, it's good to turn it on before you go to bed, but wouldn't it be convenient to press it and go to sleep when you want to reserve a specific time in advance? 8. The UV function can be used in all courses, and if you press and hold the UV button for 3 seconds, you can also do a strong wash! 9. You can use it in detail with 8 different washing courses. From the general standard mode to the strong, eco mode, and quick wash for light dishes like glass that are easy to clean and do not need to be dried, there are various modes available. 10. The dishwasher tablet does not get caught. Oh, this is really true. Our 6-person dishwasher kept getting the tablet caught, and when I was excited to finish washing, I opened it, but the tablet was still there. I was embarrassed more than once. Maybe because it is bigger, this one does not get the tablet caught, which is great. Unlike the 6-person one, the lid opens forward, and this one opens and closes horizontally, so it feels safer. 11. This is the best part. It washes a large volume at once! This is why dryers and dishwashers are always included among items that improve the quality of life, but dishwashers are really revolutionary! It is so convenient because I can finish a large volume at once that I could not even dream of with a 6-person dishwasher! Koreans in particular use a lot of red pepper powder. The combination of red pepper powder and oil is really. Hahaha. It’s hard to wash them cleanly without hot water, but since the machine washes them so conveniently, I don’t have to struggle with getting oil on my hands, so it’s really, really good. It washes not only red pepper oil, but also stuck-on rice paste and seasoning really, really well! I feel so relieved ^^ They say that this is because the water is sprayed from the upper, middle, and lower three groups with a high temperature of about 75 degrees Celsius. Every time I see it, I’m amazed at how the dishwasher cleans even such detailed parts. 12. The dishes shine more when you use the dishwasher than when you just wash them, so they become sparkling. It’s also thanks to the rinse in the tablet dishwasher, but they shine more, and since they’re washed cleanly and UV-sterilized, they’re more hygienic, neat, and great. 13. It even dries automatically, so I’m really satisfied! Wow~! After washing, the automatic door opening function intelligently discharges moisture, and the powerful drying function that uses two turbo fans is great because it allows for strong drying. It is not completely dry the moment washing is complete, but it is great because there are no water stains compared to the one I used before after natural drying. 14. It is hygienic and easy to manage with an all-stainless steel inner tube + triple filtration filter! 15. It is definitely much quieter. My husband likes it because it is much quieter than the one he used ^^ Cons: It is not completely dry right after it is finished and needs natural drying time. Since it is for 12 people, it is quite large in size. Since I need enough space, I ended up doing an unexpected house cleaning before receiving it. ; ; Since it is an old house, the sink height is low, so I couldn't install it as a built-in, so I installed it as a stand. Instead, thanks to it, the kitchen is clean after a long time. Securing enough space before receiving it! Precautions Never open it while using it or after washing it. There is a risk of burns, so if you open it in the middle, you can get hurt by the hot steam. Be sure to use a dishwasher-specific detergent. Otherwise, it will not only not clean well, but it can also cause the machine to break down. Thanks to this, my personal time has increased and my quality of life has improved! I am really very satisfied with it. I should have bought a bigger one sooner. Oh, by the way, we installed it a little higher than the built-in one, so there was an additional fee. You can wash small and light dishes in the middle and heavy and large dishes at the bottom. It is so new and convenient that you can just turn the top or just separate the bottom to wash the dishes. I liked that I didn’t have to fill it all the way up because I thought it was a waste of water and electricity. 5. It has a locking function! When I saw this, I thought the buttons were in the perfect place for a baby to press, and it has a locking function. Sentence (English): This Bosch dishwasher cleans well, and the cycle runs for a long time at piping hot temperatures, but I have a couple of minor complaints and/or suggestions.
Comments (English): [ Cleans Well, But .  ] || ---------------- || This Bosch dishwasher cleans well, and the cycle runs for a long time at piping hot temperatures, but I have a couple of minor complaints and/or suggestions. First, I do not like the fact that you cannot look on the display and see how much time is left on the cycle. Yes, you can do this on your phone, once you have it linked via WiFi, but my wife and I preferred to just look at the display and know how much time was left so that we could add things . I mean, why take away this feature? Second, what is purpose of the handle-looking thing on the second level rack (hard to describe here)? At first we thought it was to hold a sponge to get clean, and I thought, what a great idea. But in reality it must only be a handle, but not a very well-thought-out one bc the DW tablet falls into this 'handle' and stays there; sometimes when the cycle is finished, part of the tablet is still there; was this DW designed for the tablet to fall into this handle pocket, or for the table to fall down to the bottom of the DW into the area where it can mix with the hot water? Big unknown, manual does not address this. Third and finally . the very small container for flatware on the bottom rack is tucked away in the BACK of the DW . why put it way back here? do you know how many times we open the DW in the middle of the cycle to add a spoon or fork while we are cleaning up, eating dessert with company, etc. Now you have to open the door completely, pull out the bottom rack all the way, with hot steam in your face, and insert a stray utensil; if the container were designed to be up closer to the front, as it was in our last Bosch, we could just open the door and slide the utensil in the container up front. Oh, well. Positives: quiet, flush under countertop, hidden display, light on floor.

Sentence (English): Is this dishwasher quiet?
Comments (English): [ Quiet, but doesn't dry well at all ] || ---------------- || Is this dishwasher quiet? Yes. Does it dry your dishes? No. After purchasing, we found out that this was a common problem with current Bosch dishwashers. My parents have a previous generation of this dishwasher and it's fantastic at leaving the dishes clean and dry, but ours doesn't. In an effort to chase a low energy rating they sacrificed power usage, and we even have the Sanitize and Extra Dry settings on, with little to no difference. Water comes out of the upper spray nozzle when you pull out the rack, which them soaks the dishes below even more. We have a very specific order of operations now so that it doesn't make the situation worse. I don't want to go through the hassle of having it removed/replaced with a different model, so I'll do what I can to warn others to STAY AWAY from at least this model of Bosch dishwasher.

Sentence (English): We ordered a new dishwasher to replace an old Maytag.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher arrived with damaged door ] || ---------------- || We ordered a new dishwasher to replace an old Maytag. Bosch is supposedly a "buy for life" brand, so we decided to splurge a bit on the higher end 800 model. When the dishwasher arrived, I noticed that the door was not sealing correctly. There was a gap on the right side. After installing it (installation is pretty easy), I ran the dishwasher and unsurprisingly had water coming out where the dishwasher door wasn't closing properly. I looked online for what to do and decided to try to fix this through Bosch's warranty. I contacted Bosch's support and they had a tech come out a few days later. The tech saw that the door was damaged and said it was due to mishandling in transit. He recommended I see if Lowe's can do anything. Unfortunately, Lowe's has a very small window of return/exchange when it comes to appliances. It is only 48 hours and this had long past. The tech had to order parts for the door and will come back to fix it when they come in. This is all covered by Bosch's warranty so there is nothing out of pocket on my end, but it has now been almost 3 weeks of owning a brand new supposedly top of the line dishwasher and we are unable to use it. If you are reading reviews for this product and have received a damaged appliance, reach out to Lowe's IMMEDIATELY. Forget the warranty. Do not let that 48 hour window go by like I did.
